name: Infest
summary: Infest is a roguelike deckbuilder where you manipulate the battleground Pixel-by-Pixel. Every pixel is physically simulated to burn, freeze, corrode, shock, and melt. Deploy a carefully-crafted deck to unleash impressive chain reactions on the alien infestation!

name: A Call From Under the House
summary: A Lovecraftian detective game using point-and-click style gameplay where the player must investigate a house suspected of cultish activity.

name: Second Sun
summary: Second sun is a RPG High-octane FPS which uses a mix of open maps with procedurally generated dungeons, points of interest, and loot to make every encounter exciting! Use your inhuman abilities to save the Empire from being destroyed and prevent the world from being taken over by evil.

name: Oneway.exe
summary:
oneway.exe is a first-person, single player horror game, with a heavy focus on story and internet culture. Explore, survive and solve puzzles to find out what happened to UNTITLED.EXE, its developers, and understand why you're in the middle of it.

Face the internet horrors that haunt your past. The one's you've never heard of. They don't exist.

name: Dawnfolk
summary: Minimalist and relaxing survival builder perfect for short gaming sessions. Rebuild and manage your realm, collect resources and decide the fate of your people. Explore the darkness and unveil the secrets of the black monoliths to bring back light to the world.

name: Erenshor
summary: Erenshor is a single player nod to the MMORPGs of the past. Created specifically for the nostalgic gamer who no longer wants to commit to online or scheduled play times, it offers unrestricted exploration, strategic battles, and countless weapons, armors, and spells to discover.

name: Beacon Patrol
summary: Beacon Patrol is a cooperative and relaxing tile laying exploration game. You play as captains of the Coast Guard, navigating the coast of the North Sea to secure its beacon buoys, lighthouses and waterways. Work together with your friends and score points by creating the most complete map.

name: Outside the Blocks
summary: Unleash your creativity and design your own diorama in Outside the Blocks ‒ a full-featured model builder. Shape the terrain, assemble modular houses, add decorations and put your creation on display!

name: Camper Van: Make it Home
summary: Decorate and organize the camper van of your dreams! Embark on a journey of self-discovery as you build your own home-on-wheels, using a combination of creative block organization puzzles and relaxing interior design. Make your heart feel at ease and your camper van feel like home.

name: Death In Abyss
summary: Death In Abyss is an intense flight shooter that challenges you to utilize your maneuverability and explosive firepower to survive against the deep sea hostilities.

name: Songs of Life
summary: Card drama adventure game. With the epidemic, no one can be left alone. You will play as Hua Tuo, Zhang Zhongjing and Dong Feng, with the help of surgery, potions, and even the power of the gods, to end this tragic chaos, uncover the truth of the world and destroy the culprits of it all.

name: Unbroken
summary:
Brave the hostile lands in search of your goal. Forge your own path and discover the many secrets of the realm and the looming Township of Westfall. Unlock new abilities, perks and weapons. Soak in the atmosphere and head forth against all odds.

A mood heavy action-adventure, Unbroken takes players on a grindhouse journey to Crests Edge in search of the traitor Nielsen. With multiple routes to achieve your goal (or even abandon it), the ascent to one of the multiple endings will be a memorable one.

With a unique lore structure and one of a kind audio visual composition, Unbroken will take players on a trip.

name: Super Power Racing
summary:
Get ready to experience a thrilling top-down arcade racing game that's inspired by the classic 90s racing games you know and love.

Super Power Racing League is the prestigious racing competition where ruthless competitors from around the world come together to tear up the track and power their way to victory.

Get ready to feel the adrenaline rush of Super Power Racing League, where the competition is fierce and the stakes are high. Start your engines and let the race begin!

name: Awita: Journey of Hope
summary: Awita: journey of hope is side-scroller metroidvania about a girl who saves her village from a terrible epidemic. She has to explore the big dangerous world, meet new friends and enemies and find out the secrets of the kingdom.

name: Castle of Blackwater
summary: Castle of Blackwater is a multiplayer social deduction game where 10 players navigate a magical 2D castle while completing tasks and uncovering hidden allegiances. Players are assigned to three different factions, each equipped with unique abilities that support their role in the game. While alive, participants use various tools to gather information and identify threats, while eliminated players can influence the outcome by collecting souls to purchase power-ups for their team. Through alliance-building, deception, and strategic ability usage, players work to ensure their faction's survival and ultimate control of the castle.

name: JDM: Japanese Drift Master
summary: Welcome to Japan, the drift capital of the world! Compete, drift, and race on miles of varied roads and winding mountain trails. Drive through towns nestled at the scenic Haikama Lake. Spend your savings on new cars and get a taste of Japanese tuning style.

name: Total Reload
summary:
Ever had something turn out so disastrously that you wished you could just reset and start all over again? In this game you may just have the chance to reboot the grandest experiment ever gone wrong. That experiment? The Universe itself.

You will find yourself inside an amazing single mechanism, impressive in its scale. Taking control of its silent resident Artificial Intelligence named HAWKING, you will be able to visit many locations filled with a variety of technical devices.

Solve spatial puzzles, change the fundamental laws of physics to activate all systems of this incredible mechanism and launch a process called TOTAL RELOAD!

name: Rise Again
summary: An action RPG where a wizard hack and slash enemies, transforming into a roguelike dungeon crawler.

name: The Precinct
summary: Averno City, 1983. Gangs rule the streets and your father lies restless in his grave. Clean up the city, uncover the truth, and embark on thrilling vehicle chases through destructible environments in this neon-noir action sandbox police game.

name: CraftCraft: Fantasy Merchant Simulator
summary: CraftCraft is an RPG merchant sim with actual. Crafting. Create a tiara for a mermaid princess or a sword made of dragon blood - you choose! Express your creativity in your very own cozy crafting studio and change the lives of quirky locals in the mysterious port town of Windspell.

name: Rogue Labyrinth
summary: Fight through the ranks in a monster-filled labyrinth created by an egocentric billionaire colonist. Make friends (or enemies) with rivals, employees, fans, and monsters to improve your abilities. The crowd wants a show, so hype them up in this rogue-lite narrative adventure!

name: Gundroid
summary: Earth is in danger in this classic Run N' Gun action spectacle inspired by the glory days of gaming from the late 80s and 90s! Take control of G.U.N.N.R and and battle your way through hordes of enemies and boss fights accompanied by a rocking soundtrack.

name: Museum No.9
summary: Massive artifact collection! Build your museum with extreme freedom! Visitor revenue depends on your route design, and whether you can achieve perfect profits is entirely up to you! Enjoy light rogue-style adventure exploration, and use different skill combinations to battle monsters every time!

name: Kiborg
summary: Kiborg is a fast-paced, story-driven action game with rogue-lite encounters. Each challenge is unique and the narrative always moves forward, win or lose. Become an unstoppable war machine and face the consequences of your actions as you lead a resistance group on a faraway prison planet.

name: Underquest
summary: Cute fantasy roguelite with backpack mechanics. Combine items to create powerful skills and use them in fast-paced combat. Explore randomly generated dungeons in the Underkingdom and discover the secrets of its inhabitants!

name: Wizard of Legend 2
summary: Face perilous magical trials in the fast-paced rogue-lite follow-up to the acclaimed original, featuring up to 4-player co-op and vibrant new 3D visuals. Master new Arcana and elements, experiment with spell combinations, and seek immortality to become a Wizard of Legend!

name: Cataclismo
summary: The Cataclismo left us broken. Construct fortresses and defend against waves of Horrors in this mix of tower defense and real-time strategy. Lead an expedition beyond the gates of the last city, and reclaim mist-shrouded ruins as you rebuild humanity—stone by stone.

name: Lost Skies
summary: Chart a course in a breathtaking, but fractured world. Explore ancient ruins, master advanced technology, and craft your very own skyship to brave nature’s fury and colossal threats in Lost Skies. Team up with friends or go it alone in this awe-inspiring cooperative survival adventure.

name: The Diary
summary: Several diaries gradually reveal the thrilling story of a missing case; after multiple deductions, are the answers in the past or present? With frequent plot twists, you never know which is the truth and which is the unexpected; in a dense fog, time buries the past, but the marks remain.

name: Dunk City Dynasty
summary: Dunk City Dynasty is an NBA and NBPA licensed 3v3 streetball mobile game where you can takeover the streets with NBA superstars like Stephen Curry, Kevin Durant, Paul George, Luka Dončić, James Harden and many more! With different teams to choose from, you can dive into exciting game modes like 11-point, Full Court 5v5, and Ranked matches for hours of entertainment.

name: Supraworld
summary: Supraworld is a first-person puzzle metroidvania. Be tiny in a handcrafted toy world. Explore, solve puzzles, ignore the main quest, get out of bounds, find secret areas, convict murderers. Hunt for powerful new abilities to unravel this vast, interconnected world… And don't forget to save the princess.

name: Sword of the Sea
summary:
Sword of the Sea is an action-adventure game developed by Giant Squid, the studio behind Abzû and The Pathless.

Set in a vast desert landscape, players control a character known as the Wraith, exploring ruins and uncovering a lost world. Movement is centered on the "Hoversword," a tool that combines surfing, skateboarding, and snowboarding mechanics. The game emphasizes fluid traversal, atmospheric exploration, and light puzzle-solving.

name: Metal Gear Solid Delta: Snake Eater
summary: The same gripping story and engrossing world, but now with cutting-edge graphics and 3D audio, which bring the jungle to life. Get ready for the ultimate survival, stealth and action experience.

name: Eclipsium
summary: Eclipsium is a trippy and surreal horror game that will take you on a journey through darkness and confusion. In this haunting and immersive experience, you'll need to traverse a dark and twisted world to reach a tower that's looming in the distance.

name: Galactic Glitch
summary: Galactic Glitch is a roguelike shooter, with Physics! Throw rocks, catch missiles, and rip apart your enemies - then use them as ammo! Craft your own builds from a large array of weapons and powers. Explore the far reaches of this simulated universe, become more powerful, and discover its secrets.

name: Flick Shot Rogues
summary: Flick Shot Rogues is a turn-based rogue-lite that turns movement into a skill shot! Aim and flick your hero to ricochet through levels, dodge enemy attacks, and smash your foes with crazy trick shots. Featuring near-endless replayability, fun upgrades, and a ton of mayhem.

name: Techno Banter
summary: Surrounded by bright neons, filthy streets and even filthier techno beats, it is you who guard the entrance to the rave. Sharpen your wits and deliver lyrical smackdowns to those not worthy of partying. But beware - the stakes may or may not involve blowing up the city.

name: Cabernet
summary: Cabernet is a 2D narrative RPG set in 19th century Eastern Europe. Guide Liza, a young vampire struggling with her morality and the supernatural world she has been pulled into. Beware, the taste of Cabernet is not for the faint of heart - prepare to explore themes of social conflict, alcoholism, and corruption.

name: Casting Whispers
summary: Sound is your only hope for survival in this first-person psychological horror game. Investigate the mysteries of an apartment block in 1960s America terrorized by a cosmic horror, as you try to save your lost mentor… and yourself.

name: The RPG
summary: Minimalistic Skyrim + West of Loathing + Supraland. An RPG-lite adventure with intentionally twisted traditional role-playing games aspects, where your choices do matter.

name: Schrott
summary: SCHROTT - the roguelite driving game: Pull off insane stunts, collect valuable loot, and customize your absurd vehicle.

name: Bubble Ghost Remake
summary: Guide a small ghost and its bubble through an enchanted castle full of dangers and challenges in this incredible remake of the popular classic "Bubble Ghost". With over 40 levels of skill that include ingenious puzzles and challenging obstacles, get ready for hours of addictive gameplay.

name: Warhammer 40,000: Speed Freeks
summary:
Blaze into the high-Orktane mayhem of clashing Speedmobs, in adrenaline-fueled combat racing through the brutal Warhammer 40,000 universe! Drive scrappy vehicles loaded with bombastic weapons and powerful abilities to krump the opposing team!

Assemble your mob of dakka-spitting wagons, pushing their team to victory across multiple maps in this explosively unique take on the combat racing and shooter genres. Obliterate your Ork foes with kunnin’ strategies and brute force as your team speeds towards ultimate glory.

Are you looking for more speed and more dakka in your life? Look no further YA GITS!

name: Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma
summary: The classic action-RPG and life-simulation gameplay, beloved by Rune Factory fans across the globe, is taken in a bold new direction in Guardians of Azuma. This all-new adventure takes place in the never-before-seen eastern country of Azuma where you will assume the Earth Dancer powers and fight against the spreading Blight to bring hope back to this once-prosperous land.

name: Daemon x Machina: Titanic Scion
summary:
From Marvelous First Studio comes an action-packed new entry in the Daemon X Machina series. Fly into battle in your customized Arsenal, unleashing a variety of attacks tailored to your playstyle. Feel the exhilaration of fast-paced combat as you freely explore a deadly and dangerous open world on land or in the air. After taking down your foes, collect their weapons and equipment, and upgrade your skills to expand your options on the battlefield. Suit up for a dark sci-fi story where you can face the titanic boss battles alone or with up to two other players online. New and veteran Daemon X Machina players alike will find a worthy adventure here.

Created and produced by Kenichiro Tsukuda and featuring stunning mechanical designs from Shoji Kawamori, Daemon X Machina: Titanic Scion takes the franchise in a dramatic new direction.

Humanity’s fight for liberation begins now!

name: One-Eyed Likho
summary:
One-Eyed Likho is a grim first-person horror adventure set in a world inspired by a dark, Slavic fairy tale “The One-eyed Likho”. Likho, is an embodiment of evil fate and misfortune in Slavic mythology, a creature with one eye, often depicted as an old, skinny woman in black.

Embark on an exhilarating journey through a haunting realm brought to life from a forgotten Slavic fairy tale of the 19th century. Immerse yourself in a captivating world rendered in mesmerizing greyscale, presented in an immersive 4:3 aspect ratio that adds depth to your adventure.

name: Hunter: The Reckoning - The Beast of Glenkildove
summary: Full moon. Cold night. Dark shadow. Warm gun. The Beast of Glenkildove has stalked Ireland for centuries. Now, you must hunt it. A text-based interactive novel set in the World of Darkness.

name: Solar Descent
summary:
An action-adventure game for the Playdate handheld console in the vein of classic The Legend of Zelda games combined with modern ideas found in e.g. Dark Souls and Hollow Knight.

Solar Descent features real-time combat, two attack buttons, on the fly switching of abilities, clever combat integration of the crank, elaborate menus and map systems.

name: Mark of the Deep
summary: Mark of the Deep is an epic pirate-themed adventure with strong narrative and a thrilling mix of Metroidvania and Souls-Like elements. Embark on this journey as the fierce Marcus "Rookie" Ramsey and explore the mysteries of a cursed island to find your missing pirate crew.

name: Radix Chronicle
summary: Radix is a tactical RPG inspired by SNES and early Playstation classics. With dark themes but bright characters, this fantasy tale changes depending on how you fight! Your magic can even alter the land itself. Use your timing and skill, rather than your luck, to lead your party home safely each day!

name: Dark Hours
summary: Dark Hours is a co-op survival horror game for 1-4 players. Your heist has been disrupted by a supernatural event, and your team of robbers is now trapped with an evil entity. Forget your plan, your mission is to survive. Explore and cooperate to find a way out or hide and pray for daylight.

name: Pilo and the Holobook
summary: Join Pilo and Prof on a new space adventure! Use your Holobook to turn everything into stickers and create your encyclopedia of a new world. Explore new beautiful planets and meet new friends in this sweet adventure game.

name: Ascend
summary: Ascend is an adventure puzzle game where a young woman must navigate to the top of a mystical mountain learning the secrets of both the past and the future to find the balance in all aspects of life.

name: Parcel Simulator
summary: Inspect and dissect parcels and packages in this parcel inspection simulator! Examine labels for mistakes, contents for contraband and hone your parcel reviewing skills. Build, upgrade and expand your warehouse to take your parcel inspections to the next level!

name: Grifford Academy
summary: Grifford Academy is a story-rich, coming-of-age RPG set in a mystical book realm where your decisions shape the personalities of the characters. Engage in strategic turn-based combat as you set out to discover the secrets of Caldria.

name: Crashlands 2
summary: Slap your way across a vibrant world where interstellar friendships are the key to your survival. Befriend eccentric aliens, craft bizarre weaponry, and stick it to the man in this sequel to the award-winning open world crafting RPG Crashlands.

name: Bye Sweet Carole
summary: Bye Sweet Carole is a horrific thriller game inspired by the greatest animation movies and created by Chris Darril. (Remothered series) Be ready to jump into the world of Corolla and meet the rabbits that has infested it.

name: Yes, Your Grace: Snowfall
summary: In this new reality, where monsters seem closer, enemies stronger and your petitioners struggling more than ever, your duties as a King must continue. It will be your responsibility to rebuild the trust of your kingdom, protect your family and survive the upcoming winter.

name: Baby Steps
summary: Play as Nate, an unemployed failson with nothing going for him, until one day he discovers a power he never knew he had… putting one foot in front of the other. Explore a world shrouded in mist, one step at a time. Hike the serene mountains by placing each footstep yourself, in original physics-based gameplay from the minds behind Ape Out and Getting Over It. Take in the sights, fall in love with the local fauna, and try to find meaning in a wasted life.

name: Cipher Zero
summary: A minimalist logic game. Can you solve for 𝒙?

name: Angeline Era
summary:
Pick up your sword and hit the road!

Every level is hidden in plain sight in this nonlinear 3D Action-Adventure game! Travel a vast country's unmarked overworld in search of the next challenging fight, humorous encounter, or mysterious landscape. YOU decide what you discover next in this world of Fae, Humans and Angels!

The Angel's mothership, Throne, lays dormant behind a fierce storm. To reach it, unlock its secrets, and usher in the future, you must explore the land of Era and survive its trap-filled ruins, primordial forests, treacherous mountains, mines, and more! Overcome intense battles and hilarious hazards in this tale of betrayal, haunting lore, and fruitless yearning.

From Anodyne 2 and Sephonie's devs, Melos and Marina.

name: Everdeep Aurora
summary: An ongoing apocalyptic meteor shower has forced the world’s population to settle underground. As Shell, a feline child who awakens to find her mother missing, drill downward from the surface layer through a tile-based underground and discover the Everdeep.

name: Steel Seed
summary: Steel Seed is a single player stealth-action adventure game set in a dark sci-fi world. In her epic journey inside a hostile underground facility run by AIs, Zoe is alone with Koby, a flying drone, as her only companion.

name: Fretless: The Wrath of Riffson
summary: In this turned-based RPG, wield powerful legendary instruments, gather mighty riff attacks and save the land from Rick Riffson's devilish goons and musical hybrid monsters!

name: South of Midnight
summary: South of Midnight is a new action-adventure from Compulsion Games. Explore the mythos and confront mysterious creatures of the Deep South in this modern folktale while learning to weave an ancient power to surmount obstacles and face the pain haunting your hometown.

name: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector
summary: Citizen Sleeper 2: Starward Vector is a narrative-driven science-fiction RPG in which players take on the role of a Sleeper, an artificial human. Using a tabletop-inspired dice system, players manage resources, make difficult choices, and build relationships while seeking a new life among the settlements of the Starward Belt. Expanding on the original game, the sequel introduces a customizable ship, recruitable crew members, and high-risk contracts that require planning and adaptation. Player choices, character classes, and skill-based interactions shape both the story and the path forward.

name: A.I.L.A
summary: A.I.L.A. is a first-person horror game set in a near-future filled with immersive technology. Play as the sole game tester for a revolutionary new fictional AI. Survive intense horror experiences that prey on your deepest fears as the lines between virtual and reality begin to blur…

name: Everhood 2
summary: An unconventional arpg where you battle enemies through musical encounters while being accompanied by a Raven who promises you to retrieve your voice if you slay the mighty Mind Dragon!

name: Monster Mop Up
summary: Rescue the scared little Ragamuffins from the human world- and clean up all evidence of their existence. Mop stains, burn poop, and get rewarded with high tech gear and upgrades. Save enough, and you can even expand your home, decorate it, and live happily ever after with your fluffy little friends!

name: While Waiting
summary: A transformative adventure exploring the art of waiting. Clear the game by doing nothing, but discover the power of acceptance and patience in 100+ situations from birth to death. Learn to embrace life as you wait.

name: Hidden Pass
summary: Hidden Pass is a tactical turn-based RPG with base management that blends tactics with fascinating visual effects. The game sets in unique technomagic fantasy world. Plan your steps carefully while you lead an expedition to the center of a vast cluster of uncharted isles floating high in the sky.

name: Paradise Lust 2
summary: Continue your adventures on Tuvatuva island in a sultry 2D point-and-click adventure where romance blooms, fish are caught, drinks are served, puzzles are solved, and passion ignites in paradise.

name: Damned 2
summary: Damned 2 is a asymmetrical multiplayer (4vs1) horror game where a group of survivors must come together to solve puzzles and escape an immersive environment while another player takes the role of a unbeatable monster ready to slay all trespassers.

name: Aftershock: Coastline
summary: Aftershock: Coastline is a thrilling retro-styled survival horror shooter inspired by the design of Resident Evil and the atmosphere of Bioshock. Spend an hour delving deep into a seaside bunker in an uncanny land, uncovering its secrets and surviving against the cosmic horrors which dwell within.

name: Le Mans Ultimate
summary: Le Mans is a continually evolving story... powered by emotion, speed and glory. Le Mans Ultimate – the official game of the FIA World Endurance Championship & 24 Hours of Le Mans.

name: Dreamcore
summary: Step into the surreal with Dreamcore, a body-cam styled psychological horror game that plunges you into the eerie beauty of "liminal spaces." Unravel the mysteries of Dreamcore’s non-linear worlds and uncover its hidden secrets. Can you discover what lies beyond the edge of reality?

name: Backpack Battles
summary: The inventory management auto battler! Buy rare and legendary items to build powerful setups. Then battle other players with it.

name: Wanderer: The Fragments of Fate
summary: Step into the unknown and embark on an epic, time travel adventure, completely re-imagined. Introducing Wanderer: The Fragments of Fate, a remake of the critically acclaimed VR adventure game - Wanderer. There’s no telling where you’ll go and who you’ll become as you unravel the mysteries of time.

name: Vaporwave Pinball
summary: Play LoFi digital pinball in a variety of cosy, chill locations. Explore a 90s operating system to find new worlds. Uncover hidden, corrupted files. For a couple of hours, escape the real world. Vaporwave Pinball is the ultimate "virtual holiday" destination.

name: Vilde
summary: Vilde is a Norse myth-inspired roguelite FPS. Procedurally generated levels and RPG elements. Battle resurrected foes, earn boons, and permanently upgrade your character. Join 4-player co-op or play alone in a dark and epic world inspired by Norse mythology and Viking culture

name: The Deadly Path
summary: A building management, tower defense game set in an occult dungeon. Create your dungeon, defend against raides and build the idol in order to bring your dark lord into being and bring about the age of reckoning.

name: Pale Coins
summary: Journey into the ruthless open world of Pale Coins, an old-school fantasy RPG. Face punishing bosses, goblin-infested dungeons, and discover legendary weapons as you customize your champion and fight across Grenmark for the fabled Champion's Coin.

name: Golden Chambers
summary: Live through your most dare Wild West fantasies in First Person Hellyeah-Em-Up format

name: Age of Water
summary:
Age of Water is a new MMO game set in a post-apocalyptic Earth completely covered in water.

The rooftops of high-rise buildings and tops of other man-made and natural objects turned into islands, on which the surviving people built new settlements. Your adventure begins near one of them.

name: Supervive
summary: Slam into all-out, multi-squad teamfights in this lethal, fast-paced brawl in the sky. Unlock gear, theorycraft builds, and bring your gamebreaking loadout into every match.

name: To a T
summary: to a T is a 3D narrative adventure game developed by Keita Takahashi and the uvula team, with a strong focus on character, interaction, story and exploration. Play as a teenager (Teen), with a unique posture just trying to live a normal life in a small coastal town. Explore the town along with the help of Teen’s loyal dog and loving mother. While going to school and contending with bullies, Teen discovers a new ability granted to them by their extraordinary posture, and they start to uncover more about their mysterious lineage.

name: Wheel World
summary: Dive into Wheel World as Kat, a rider chosen by ancient cycling spirits. Race elite teams, trick out your bike, and perform the long overdue Great Shift ritual to save a universe on the brink! Your bike is your destiny.

name: Typhon: Bot vs. Bot
summary:
Typhon: BvB lets you command modular mechs in a sci-fi tactical strategy game where you outthink rivals by scripting your bots with Python. A player has to customize, adapt, and evolve their forces in real time in the hostile alien world of AEGIS IVb to dominate the battlefield.

Typhon is a tactical sandbox built entirely in Python, where code is part of the battlefield. Every unit, behavior, and system is written in a language designed for clarity, flexibility, and full player control.

name: BloodRush: Undying Wish
summary:
BloodRush: Undying Wish is a top-down hack n' slash game with a dark fantasy aesthetic.

In this game, the player is encouraged to aggressively use their combat abilities to evade, control and destroy their opponents, moving around in a deadly dance of carnage.

Focused on movement abilities, split-second decision-making, and stylish strings of attacks, the game is heavily inspired by titles such as Devil May Cry, Akane, Hyper Light Drifter, Hades, and Ultrakill.

name: Skygard Arena
summary: Skygard Arena is a turn-based tactical RPG with a vibrant roster of MOBA-style Heroes. Assemble your squad, equip items and abilities, and outplay your opponents in fast-paced strategic battles. Discover the world of Skygard in a multi-campaign solo adventure, or fight in thrilling PvP matches!

name: Awakening Sarah
summary: Awakening Sarah is a 2D platformer with emphasis on exploration. Unravel the dreams and realities of Sarah, a girl who's recovering from a coma, while helping her understand the world around her and herself.

name: Dungeon Stalkers
summary: Dungeon Stalkers is a PVEVP dungeon crawler game where you can experience the joy of exploration and survival in a classic RPG. Join forces with your companions to defeat other adventurers and monsters, and acquire equipment and treasures. Then, escape safely from the witch's curse!

name: Commandos: Origins
summary: Commandos: Origins tells the story of a newly founded British commando unit that grows into a brotherhood during its operations against strategic goals of the German Wehrmacht.

name: Gex Trilogy
summary: Gex Trilogy is the definitive edition of the classic platforming series with Gexcessive attitude, complete with Gextras like rewind and save anywhere. Relive Gex's snark-laced adventures through the warped lens of twentieth-century pop culture and use your Gexterity to survive an onslaught of television-themed challenges.

name: As I Began to Dream
summary: As I Began to Dream is an enchanting puzzle-platformer that merges a unique environment manipulation mechanic. Utilize this power to navigate dream worlds, solve puzzles, and aid Lily's escape from her dream realm.

name: Let Them Come: Onslaught
summary: Survive the relentless offensive of the alien horde in Let Them Come: Onslaught, a sci-fi survival roguelite. The pursuit of the perfect build and an ever-expanding arsenal of abilities are the keys to your success.

name: Portal Fantasy
summary:
Portal Fantasy is a creature-collecting adventure RPG. Journey through an epic storyline, collecting creatures, avoiding traps, and solving thrilling quests in this RPG with a unique take on a beloved genre.

Collect unique creatures and gather ingredients to fuse and enhance your team. Discover hundreds of combinations, which can augment your creatures, teach them new skills, and even change their appearances.

Unlock Wilderness areas to battle and collect Porbles from 6 different elements with over 50 skills and 60 passive abilities. Conquer Baddies, fuse potent ingredients, and transform your Porbles into ultimate powerhouses. The battle is on!

Journey through beautiful pixelated worlds, navigating perils, solving quests, and meeting with countless quirky characters. A captivating story, tons of side content, and a charming soundtrack await you on your adventures.

Prove your mettle by tackling traps, puzzles, and obstacles. The Wilderness is a dangerous place, as you jump and maneuver across moving platforms, voids, spikes, saws, turrets, teleporters, and more.

name: Faceminer
summary: Faceminer is the dystopian narrative-driven A.I. management sim where you build a biometric data processing empire from scratch. Classify dubiously sourced data, upgrade mining infrastructure, and scale up your A.I. surveillance empire to obscene ends in this hardcore thriller clicker set in 1999.

name: Crown Gambit
summary: Choose the next sovereign in this dark fantasy game, featuring card battles and visual novel-like dialogues with multiple endings. Play your cards well, use your skills with care, and move carefully in these turn-based battles, where the weak rely on luck and the Heroes on their talent.

name: Badlands Crew
summary: Create, customize and command your battle wagon to conquer crazed enemy factions and save innocent survivors scattered throughout the lawless Badlands in the aftermath of a devastating apocalypse. Do you have what it takes to Build, Evolve and Fight to survive?

name: The Shaman's Ark
summary: The Shaman's Ark is a journey through mysterious and dark lands, full of dangers and strange encounters. As a enigmatic Shaman, you will embark on a quest to battle monsters in order to save the Ark, or condemn it to eternal darkness.

name: Club Velvet Rose: Midnight Bliss
summary: Indulge in Club Velvet Rose, an adult visual novel exploring the world of a sophisticated swingers club. Embrace desires, encounter intriguing characters, and dive into a world of passion. Expect stunning animations, inspiring dialogue, and captivating situations. Let the journey begin.

name: Undying Fortress
summary: Wield your magic sword against the monsters that fill a mysterious tower, and uncover the secrets of the past!

name: Bite Size Terrors: Reverse Blue
summary: The Bright Blue Sky... Is Hiding Something.

name: Era One
summary: Era One is an innovative space game that combines elements of real-time strategy, base building, space survival, and tactical battles. Players can create and customize their bases from scratch, construct various types of structures and warships, manage fleets, and engage in tactical space battles.

name: Relic Guardian
summary: "Relic Guardian" is a fantasy-style strategy tower defense game. As the builder on the battlefield, summon a variety of defense towers and spells with reliable hero companions to complete this epic and guarding adventure!

name: Asfalia: Panic at the Mansion
summary: A spooky shadow is on the loose within Asfalia. Join Charlie and flamboyant sidekick Lilly in their search of four adorable missing puppies. Meet amazing characters, solve fun puzzles, and collect beautiful stickers along the way! Chase the shadows away in a captivating story-driven game suitable for all ages.

name: Leila
summary: Enter the world of an everyday woman as you explore her past in this point & click narrative game. Hand-drawn animations bring her memories to life, and thought-provoking puzzles lay bare the reasons behind her choices. Immerse yourself in a story unfolds as you decipher its intricate pieces.

name: Planetary Life
summary: Manipulate climate, add plants and evolve creatures in this planet and life sandbox simulation game. From cells to civilisations, spread life throughout the whole planet. Or just enjoy watching your creation burn!

name: Power Fantasy
summary: Survive hordes of blood hungry enemies and hope for the best upgrades while you level up! Power Fantasy is a fresh rogue-survivors-like with unique heroes and tons of customization.

name: Versus
summary: Versus is an action-packed game combining 2.5D and 3D mechanics. Play as Zed on a mission to the enigmatic island of Isolux, battling fierce enemies and unraveling mysteries that only raise more questions. With unique levels, intense combat, and epic bosses, uncover the secrets lurking in Isolux.

name: Pizza Bandit
summary: Pizza Bandit is a unique blend of "cooking" and "shooting," adding extra spice to the third-person shooter. In this mission-based 4-player co-op third-person shooter, you embody a wannabe chef utilizing his ex-mercenary skills to fund his dream pizza restaurant.

name: Deconstruction Simulator
summary: Deconstruction Simulator is a game that allows you to experience the thrilling world of demolition and recycling! Take on the role of a skilled demolition manager and transform unwanted items into valuable resources.

name: Away From Home
summary: A Rhythm based RPG experience. Providing detailed pixel art and expressive animation. Experience a fun world with lots of colorful characters. Come and disrupt their peace!

name: Vinebound: Tangled Together
summary: Vinebound: Bloom & Boom is a tasty mix of horde-survival roguelite and chaotic couch co-op for 1-2 players. Coordinate your position, synchronize attacks, and defeat hordes of moldy foes while unlocking new arsenals to cultivate plantastic builds.

name: Magic Inn
summary: Reclaim glory in Magic Inn, a charming tavern life simulator. Take on the role of an exiled wizard-turned-innkeeper, overseeing everything from menus, rooms, guests, and staff in a fully magical customizable inn. Engage in card battles to spark conversations and foster relationships with guests.

name: Niktophobia
summary: Niktophobia is a Sci-fi PC and VR horror for 1-4 players. The team arrives at the space station to extract alien bio-samples. Confronting an advanced alien AI, players will use various tools and manipulate the station's energy to get out of trouble together

name: Detective Dotson
summary: Chase down criminals, spy on bad guys and solve cases! Change into a disguise or recruit a team member - your choices matter! Enjoy multi-genre gameplay and watch thrilling episodes. Games and stories from the endlessly intriguing modern day India!

name: Saeko: Giantess Dating Sim
summary: You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you. Experience the fate of Saeko and the little people in this cruel yet captivating story with avant-garde art.

name: Knockout Master
summary: Knockout Master is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel that puts you in the role of a boxer, whose dream is to become the world's heavyweight champion. The game is packed with sex, romance, drama, and a rich story.

name: Constance
summary: Constance is a 2D hand-drawn action adventure featuring a paintbrush-wielding artist, striving to escape from a colorful but decaying inner-world, created by her declining mental health.

name: Recycle Bin Battle
summary: Reycle Bin Battle is an arcade puzzle game based on 3 differents gameplay. Make combo with rubishes to make ball, use ball in a breakout to get energy and finally use energy to shoot Kaiju coming from outer space.

name: Soulslinger: Envoy of Death
summary: You are a gunslinger in limbo, involved in a gritty war against "The Cartel", a ruthless organization harvesting souls to break free of the shackles of the afterlife. Grow stronger with each new run, gather the essence of lost souls to take on the biggest threats in this rogue-lite FPS!

name: Ratatan
summary: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

name: Absurd Story: Back Home
summary: A runaway wanderer, a frail Taoist priest, who want to return to their hometown at the end of the world. But when they step into the empty city, they are swept into the dead ruins…

name: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily
summary: The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a turn-based strategy game. The villainess Scarlet, deceived and falsely accused of killing of the King, becomes the first streamer. Through this, she uses manipulates and diversion to rebel against the vast military force of the Imperial Kingdom.

name: Butcher's Creek
summary: Use rusty tools to brutalize a perverted gang of serial torturers in the remote Appalachian Forest.

name: Projected Dreams
summary: Drag toys from the shelves and drop them on the table to create a shadow play in this cozy puzzle game. As the shadows unfold, immerse yourself in a heartwarming story full of nostalgia from the 90s and blur the lines between fantasy and reality.

name: Unit Down Charge
summary: A futuristic action rail-shooter! Action packed, and full of quirky character dialogues, unique level designs, and epic boss battles!

name: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
summary: 26 years on, a brand-new entry in the Fatal Fury series is set to arrive on the scene! FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves features a unique art style that stimulates the senses and an innovative REV System that supercharges the excitement. Here, at long last, a new legend is about to unfold…

name: Bloodthief
summary: Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through medieval dungeons and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath the surface.

name: Woodlawn: The End of the World
summary:
When scientists try to create and control magic, their first spell goes wrong, and monsters are accidentally brought to life and destroy cities. Now the military has to hold off and contain the monsters while scientists try to figure out how to undo the spell.

The enemies AI can detect the skill of the player and automatically adjust difficulty based on player performance.

name: Titan Quest II
summary: Nemesis, Goddess of Retribution, is out of control. She is corrupting the Threads of Fate and punishing all those who oppose her. Take up your weapon, fight alongside gods, and change fate itself in Titan Quest 2, an action RPG inspired by Greek mythology.

name: Lessaria: Fantasy Kingdom Sim
summary: Lessaria is a unique strategy game that combines city building with indirect hero control. Build and manage a thriving kingdom while issuing commands and quests to guide your heroes in their adventures. Explore, conquer, and shape the destiny of your realm in this epic fantasy world.

name: Preserve
summary: Preserve is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals to create a perfect symbiosis to your liking.

name: Lost Eidolons: Veil of the Witch
summary: From the world of "Lost Eidolons" comes an all-new turn-based strategy RPG. Stranded on a mysterious island with scattered memories, your only means of survival is to fight. Recruit allies, undertake a perilous journey, and battle to reclaim what you've lost... no matter how many deaths it takes.

name: Spirit X Strike
summary: An Action Adventure Game that lets you craft unique COMBOs and explore endless ways to style on your enemies with a high-speed combat system. Test your skills in fun chaotic one-vs-group battles, intense, strategic duels, and exhilarating post-apocalyptic adventure that will set your blood boiling.

name: Dead Wells: The Devil Fragment
summary: Hack, Slash, Parry and Dodge your foes in this Souls-like Action RPG. Explore the countryside in search of The Devil Fragment while fighting enemies with a multi game inspired combat system where you can launch foes into the air and then juggle them to build your combo meter for multiple buffs.

name: Magical Girl Konoha
summary: To aid the King, Priestess Konoha plunges into "Grimoire"! The world inside "Grimoire" is formed by another world called Grimoire Land in which Konoha becomes a magical girl, and has come to save the world!

name: Narrenschiff
summary: "Narrenschiff" is a psychological horror puzzle game. Players take on the role of an amnesiac man who awakens in a mysterious mental hospital. As they explore, they unravel a story involving their own origins and the conspiracy brewing within the walls of the mental institution.

name: Endzone 2
summary: Endzone 2 is a post-apocalyptic survival colony builder, where you embark to secure humanities survival after a cataclysmic disaster. Discover and repopulate the last habitable grounds, while the survival of your people hinges on your wits, foresight, and resilience in a harsh and unforgiving world.

name: Little Nightmares III
summary:
Embark on a new adventure in the unique world of Little Nightmares.

In Little Nightmares III, you follow the journey of Low & Alone, as they search for a path that could lead them out of the Nowhere.

Trapped within the Spiral, a cluster of disturbing places, the two friends will have to work together to survive in a dangerous world full of delusions and escape the grasp of an even greater threat lurking in the shadows.

For the first time in the franchise, face your childhood fears together with a friend using online co-op, or solo with an AI companion.

name: Killing Floor III
summary: It's 2091. Megacorporation Horzine has produced the ultimate army: an obedient horde of bioengineered monstrosities called "Zeds." Now, only the rebel group Nightfall stands between these infernal creations and the future of humanity.

name: Half-Life 2 RTX
summary: Re-live the groundbreaking, critically acclaimed Half-Life 2 like never before, reimagined with RTX Remix. Featuring full ray tracing, remastered assets, and DLSS 3.5 with Ray Reconstruction in this free DLC for Half-Life 2 owners.

name: Tormented Souls II
summary: Caroline Walker returns in the sequel to the award-winning survival horror classic. Explore the decaying remains of the secluded Villa Hess, use improvised weapons to confront terrifying creatures, and bend the fabric of reality to save your sister from a twisted cult.

name: Infinity Islets
summary: A relaxing fantasy archeology sandbox. Dig through the sands of Infinity Islets to unearth hidden interdimensional artifacts. Your mission is to return these artifacts to the museum, bringing it back to its former glory.

name: Blood Moon Horror
summary: Blood Moon Horror is a 1-8 player co-op survival horror game. Survive the nightmare under the alien-infested moon, navigate the abandoned lunar base, evade extraterrestrial predators, and uncover the dark secrets lurking in the shadows.

name: Mayhemers
summary: Mayhemers is game where you can create chaos and mayhem in different type of places. Play solo or up to 4 people against AI or challenge with other players in 3v3 pvp game mode.

name: Million Depth
summary: Embark on an adventure, exploring a million subterranean floors of a fallen Earth. Trace the remnants of humanity that once dwelled below, all in search of "YOU". Utilize a crafting system that transforms your drawings into weapons to survive the challenging underground world.

name: Toree Saturn
summary: Toree Saturn is a speed based 3D Platformer featuring a round bird with sunglasses and a backpack!

name: Morikomori Life
summary:
Morikomori Life is a social and simulation game featuring Ghibli-style artwork, with a core experience that is based on farming and social relationships. The main character, Kaon, receives a secret letter from her grandmother, which leads her back to her childhood hometown of Komori, a quiet village far from the hustle and bustle of the city, where she experiences a healing life.

The Japanese-style paradise-like village is depicted using 3D toon shading to reproduce realistic textures, bringing the animated world to life. The village is filled with pleasant Japanese landscapes, where players enjoy fishing, farming, housing, and other activities.

name: Fomography
summary: Fomography is a story-driven adventure photography game. Play as a boy exploring his entire lifetime to rediscover and chronicle his memories. What has been forgotten that only the photos can show? What hidden memories do even the photos refuse to share?

name: Blood Rush
summary: BLOOD RUSH is a fast paced, skill based FPS, mixed with roguelites elements. Upgrade yourself, buy unique guns, drain miracles from relics and destroy anyone or anything standing on your way!

name: Wildwood Down
summary: Step into the hilariously twisted world of Wildwood Down, a side-splitting comedy horror point-and-click adventure set in the charming heart of Wildwood, NJ, where every corner hides a blend of mystery and laughter, perfect for fans of the genre and new comers looking for a wild ride!

name: Private Military Manager: Tactical Auto Battler
summary: You are the CEO of a private military company. Recruit capable mercenaries, purchase weapons, and develop your mercenaries according to their roles and characteristics. Observe how your mercenaries perform in combat and plan your tactics to ensure mission success.

name: Scarred
summary: Scarred is a first-person atmospheric horror puzzle game where you must uncover the truth about one of your schoolmates before it’s too late. Traverse a world of nightmares inspired by nostalgic Singaporean architecture as you fight to survive.

name: Ascendant
summary: Ascendant is set in a magical dungeon where you must recapture the souls of escaped creatures. Take on the role of a fearsome mage collecting wand caps and amulets to unlock powerful abilities. Defeat legendary abominations to acquire ascendant caps and fight your way to freedom.

name: Gedonia 2
summary: Gedonia 2 is an online coop RPG, which allows up to 4 players to freely explore living open world and build absolutely unique characters. An expanded and improved sequel for RPG Gedonia.

name: Memoriapolis
summary: Memoriapolis is a historical city builder where your city grows organically across 5 ages, from Antiquity to the Industrial Revolution. Manage resources, interact with factions, and shape your dynasty toward building a final Wonder with easy, normal, or hard difficulty levels.

name: LoneStar
summary:
LoneStar is a strategic Roguelike spaceship combat game. As a bounty hunter, you will capture criminals scattered across the universe. Win the shockwave battle to gain bounty rewards and vacations. Find the treasures, customize your spaceship, unlock talents, defeat the felons and be a legend!

The Bounty Hunter Association is recruiting now! Abundant rewards await you!

name: Break Arts III
summary: Freely customize your own robots to win high-speed matches! With the brand new Co-op Mode and Diorama Mode, this game is a fresh new addition to the series.

name: Century of Anticipation
summary: Locked away at home, time slows to a crawl, your only company is yourself. In this short adventure, your challenge might be the toughest of all: make time pass again!

name: Horses
summary: In Horses, you will take on the role of a summer worker taking a break from his college studies. You will be responsible for taking care of the farm and its animals for a fortnight. Each day, as you explore the farm, you'll encounter many "surprises," peeling back the layers of the farm's unsettling mysteries.

name: Endless RPG: Untold Tales
summary: Craft a party of diverse characters, each with customizable skills and looks. Explore a living world with dynamic day-night cycles, changing seasons, and diverse biomes. Embark on an epic journey where you shape your destiny as the director of your unique story.

name: Popucom
summary: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

name: Assetto Corsa EVO
summary: Assetto Corsa EVO is the sequel to 2014’s racing simulator Assetto Corsa, which featured a range of road, track, racing, historic and drift cars as well as laser-scanned tracks

name: Trash Goblin
summary: A cosy and moreish fantasy shop sim where you uncover, clean, upcycle and sell a vast variety of trinkets - both invaluable and unlovable - to a diverse cast of fascinating customers across a colourful fantasy city. Think Potionomics meets PowerWash Simulator, with a unique protagonist!

name: The Local
summary: A fast-paced parkour game set in the Australian outback. Rail grind around the long abandoned country to complete orders or compete in timed courses. Master the movement mechanics and conquer the leaderboards.

name: The Diner at the End of the Galaxy
summary: Build your diner. Grow exotic ingredients and create a menu for your intergalactic guests. Send expeditions to outer worlds in search of loot. Form alliances and rivalries with powerful factions and shape the fate of the galaxy. Welcome to the Diner at the End of the Galaxy.

name: Asurajang
summary: Asurajang is a new Battle Royale experience that mixes in melee combat that packs a punch and trendy anime style graphics. Pick your favorite character and engage in strategic combat to become the last team standing in Asurajang.

name: The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered
summary: Explore Cyrodiil like never before with stunning new visuals and refined gameplay in The Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion Remastered.

name: Heavenstrafer
summary: Heavenstrafer is a fast paced movement shooter with a gun combo system that rewards aggressiveness and experimentation. Explore the ruins of hell and destroy angels (and demons) across three chapters filled with small but challenging arenas.

name: Disco Samurai
summary: Disco Samurai is a unique rhythm combat game in a cyberpunk setting. Challenge your skills by smoothly combining attacks, parries, dashes and other abilities to the beat of the electronic music. Crank up the volume and seize the rhythm of the electrifying soundscape of synthwave and rock!

name: Tales of the Shire
summary: Welcome home, Hobbit! Live the cosy life of a Hobbit in the wonderfully serene landscape of the Shire. Discover, decorate, & share in this idyllic corner of Middle-earth. Join friendly Hobbits & familiar faces awaiting your arrival in Tales of the Shire: A The Lord of the Rings Game.

name: Rusty Rabbit
summary: Millennia after humanity abandoned the planet, rabbits claimed their place... Stamp, a cute bunny with an old soul, pilots his trusty mech "Junkster" through the giant ruins of a frozen world in this 2.5D action belt scroller.

name: Stray Path
summary: Stray Path is an adventure and strategy game combining FreeCell and roguelike card. There are different characters and venturing in a randomly generated world. Dragging cards like FreeCell, optimizing choices, selecting equipment & items, discovering the truth of a stray world!

name: Ravenous Horde
summary: Kill hordes of zombies as a hunter, and kill hunters when you're a zombie! In this round based multiplayer post-apocalyptic FPS you start as a hunter, and turn into a zombie when you die. Level up and unlock perks, new weapons and customization options!

name: Whirlwind Magician
summary: Experience the tale of a cheerful girl and a grouchy talking hat in this charming Metroidvania, where every ability is hat-based! Throw the hat to attack enemies, teleport to him to make perilous leaps, and fly him through narrow tunnels of spikes as you escape a dangerous magic forest.

name: Texnoplazm
summary: Gun fu action centered on three intertwined movesets for punches, ranged weapons and firearms. Fight your enemies through the gothic metropolis while using their weapons against them, in the most acrobatic way possible.

name: Chasmal Fear
summary: Chasmal Fear is a next-gen FPS action horror game built in Unreal Engine 5 from the perspective of a body camera. Manage limited resources, make smart choices which affect your playthrough and survive monsters that mutate to get stronger. Played as singleplayer or Co-Op with 2 players.

name: Cryptical Path
summary: Cryptical Path is a thrilling rogue-lite dungeon crawler that pushes the boundaries of the genre. Play the Architect, build your own path, and navigate an ever-changing labyrinth you've been summoned in.

name: Bean Beasts
summary: Defeat monster hordes alongside your Bean Beasts in this cute, challenging Tower Defense Game! Evolve your companions, explore upgrade paths for traps and take on epic boss battles!

name: Temple of the Green Moon
summary: Temple of the Green Moon is a psychological thriller that will send you into the heart of a mystical journey full of mysteries and incredible discoveries.

name: Stellar Settlers
summary: Stellar Settlers is a sci-fi space-base building and colony simulation game. Take control of a space settlement, with unique vertical and horizontal base-building gameplay, build your own thriving colony on 5 hostile planets that want to destroy you. Pick and manage your talented Settlers.

name: Shadowgate PD
summary:
Shadowgate is one of the most well-known and beloved point-and-click adventure titles in gaming history. As one of the original titles in the popular MacVenture series that went on to be celebrated on the NES, GBC, and Nintendo 64, Shadowgate quickly endeared players with its fantastic atmospheric soundtrack, perilous locations to progress through, countless puzzles to solve, and more ways to gruesomely die than gamers previously thought possible.

Developed by Pixel Ghost, Shadowgate PD is being lovingly reimagined for the Playdate console using Pulp, a web based game making tool made by Panic.

name: Sunken Stones
summary: A turn based Puzzle-Strategy game about pirates and cursed treasure. Choose a captain, gather your crew and defeat monsters by strategically placing units on a 5x5 grid.

name: Little Problems
summary: Little Problems is a Cozy Detective game about solving mysteries around minor inconveniences, everyday misunderstandings, and of course, little problems. This game is not about saving the world; it's about enriching it, one case at a time.

name: Repose
summary: Repose is an dark exploration/puzzle game. In Repose, explore, fight, and maintain a healthy sleep schedule as you descend the twisted levels of the corporation that hired you for unknown reasons.

name: Shadows Labyrinth
summary: Embark on a journey through the enigmatic realm of shadows, battling countless creatures to unveil the path towards emancipation.

name: Goob
summary: Embark on an epic journey into the depths of a mysterious and treacherous underground world. This immersive adventure combines exploring vast and mysterious caves teaming with ferocious monsters, mining for precious minerals, and continuously upgrading your abilities to survive.

name: Duet Night Abyss
summary: Duet Night Abyss is a fantasy adventure RPG with a high degree of freedom developed by Hero Games' Pan Studio. The game features "multiple weapon loadouts & 3D combat" at its core, and tells the story of "Demons" from dual perspectives.

name: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure
summary: Sedap! A Culinary Adventure is a co-op cooking-combat adventure that combines the chaos of a collaborative kitchen and the wonders of adventuring into an unexplored world. Embark on an exciting culinary journey, whip up delectable delicacies, and serve your way through a fantastical reimagination of Southeast Asia!

name: Vestiges: Fallen Tribes
summary: Vestiges: Fallen Tribes is a unique blend of strategy, board game mechanics, and autobattler gameplay. Immerse yourself in a sci-fi world where tribes are battling for water, and your tactical decisions will shape the future. As a tribe leader, you’ll use a deck of cards to summon and command animated units round after round, until you come out on top.

name: Shell Runner
summary: 2045. Life's never been cheaper. Shells mean you can come back if you have money. You used to. Now you're on the bottom in a cyberpunk sprawl. Claw your way back up through wet work as a Shell Runner, in a PvE extraction looter shooter, where a gig can make you rich - or broke.

name: Spirit of the North 2
summary:
Unveil the mysteries of a beautiful ancient world in this breathtaking 3rd-Person Adventure, a sequel to the acclaimed ‘Spirit of the North.’ Take on the role of an isolated fox with a raven companion on a quest to restore the lost guardians and return home.

In an ancient world left in ruin, embark on the journey of an isolated fox far from home. With the help of a wise Raven companion, seek out the lost legendary guardians and release them from the grasp of the dark shaman Grimnir.

name: Saborus
summary: Saborus, a gripping horror adventure! Guide the brave chicken, through a deadly slaughterhouse. Solve chilling puzzles and face relentless pursuit. Can you survive?

name: Deltarune: Chapter 3
summary: A chapter for Deltarune. It released alongside chapter 4.

name: Deltarune: Chapter 4
summary: A chapter for Deltarune. It released alongside chapter 3.

name: FireBall 2
summary: Fireball 2 is an elegant and satisfying arcade-survival game about dodging swarms and triggering bombs. Take control of your fireball and weave through the massive flood of enemies. Lure the flood towards bombs and trigger them, either directly or indirectly, to take out as many enemies as possible.

name: Slyders
summary: Fight against insane hordes of demons to prevent an evil overlord from conquering Sky World in this first-person survival roguelike shooter. With an arsenal of weapons, perks, and items, the battlefield quickly transforms into a fast-paced bullet hell.

name: MycoRelic
summary: MycoRelic is a cooperative third person action-RPG set on an island inhabited by tribal robots. Raid derelict foundries and ancient temples to upgrade your body, gaining forgotten powers. Wield elemental magic to trigger powerful reactions or fight with melee and ranged weapons in dynamic combat.

name: K2: Digital Edition
summary: Easy to play, hard to survive. Rush to the summit before weather breaks or set up camps and prepare to push later. Choose the right cards for the right moment. Play turn based strategy with friends, AI or in single player mode. Popular board game adaptation consulted with real K2 climbers.

name: Over Requiemz
summary:
“Whatever pain awaits, I won’t regret this choice.”

A dark fantasy game about overcoming grief as you wander into the “Land of Oz.”

name: Supermarket Simulator
summary: Supermarket Simulator is a first-person business management game where players run and expand their own grocery store. Gameplay involves stocking shelves, managing a cash register, processing online orders, and designing the store layout. Players set prices based on fluctuating market conditions. A loan mechanic tied to a mafia storyline adds pressure through mandatory nightly repayments, creating consequences for poor financial performance.

name: Brotherhood
summary: An old-school shooter inspired by Wolfenstein 3D. You are one of the prisoners of an ancient prison. There is no one to help you. You only have yourself to rely on. Your shotgun. Against hordes of enemies. Animal rage and the desire to kill. Destroy Them All!

name: #Drive Rally
summary: Drive Rally lets you relive the 90s in the most exciting era in motorsport history, where dust, mud, and snow are badges of honor. Unleash the raw power of legendary rally beasts, admire every second of the stunning landscapes, and remember: the faster you go, the better!

name: Hollywood Animal
summary: Make your dreams come true — or crush someone else’s. Take the helm of a major Hollywood studio at the dawn of sound cinema, and guide it through decades of creative achievements and glamor, debauchery and dark deeds, tough choices and unpleasant compromises.

name: Motionrec
summary:
Motionrec is an action game that progresses through stages by recording and replaying the trajectory of your movements. Using MotionRec, you aim to clear stages quickly by recording and replaying your unique motions.

MotionRec is a gear that allows you to record, replay, and reverse-play your own movements. Customize it to your original specifications and strive for the fastest performance.

name: Isopod: A Webbed Spin-off
summary: You're a tiny pill-bug in a big world! From the creators of Webbed. Roll, zip, and slam your way through the gorgeous landscapes of the Australian bush, unite your fellow bugs, and fight back the greedy Fire Ant Conglomerate!

name: Robots at Midnight
summary: Robots at Midnight will have you embracing intense combat, unravelling deep lore, and discovering what it means to be human. In this Action RPG, explore the world of Yob as Zoe, a scrappy hero searching for her past and protecting her future.

name: Psionic Sentry: Infinite
summary: "Psionice Sentry: Infinite" is a third-person beautiful girl action shooting and tower defense game. A gameplay focused on combat and skill selection

name: Chicken Run: Eggstraction
summary: Stealth, silliness, and a whole lot of chaos! Scurry and scramble your way to freedom in this co-op adventure set in the Chicken Run universe.

name: Shantae Advance: Risky Revolution
summary: Shantae is back in an adventure 20 years in the making! The nefarious pirate Risky Boots has a “groundbreaking” new plan that will leave Sequin Land spinning — by rotating the continent, she can move any town right to the coast for easy plundering! As Shantae, turn the tectonic tables on Risky by taking control of the land itself: shift, twist, navigate, and explore by swapping between mix-and-match multilayered levels! Hair-whip and belly-dance your way through scrambled lands, misplaced towns, monster-filled crypts, and daunting labyrinths. Six creature transformations, fierce boss battles, and a 4-player versus mode await!

name: Blade Chimera
summary: In this exploration-heavy 2D action game, use your demon sword to interfere with the past, create platforms, and shield yourself from danger to explore a dystopian cyberpunk world depicted in gorgeously animated pixel art.

name: Plastic Tactics Online
summary: Battle your friends in this action-packed turn-based shooter, starring the little green army men we all know and love! Hone your tactical mastery and shooting skills in this fast-paced battle for living room supremacy- face off with both friend and foe alike to prove your mastery of Plastic Tactics!

name: Kaiserpunk
summary: Build and conquer in Kaiserpunk, the ultimate city builder and grand strategy combo set in an alternative 20th century world. Engage in epic battles on land, sea, and air, or use your economic power to emerge as the ultimate victor.

name: Neon Clash: Echoes of the Lost
summary: Young members of the Mafia fight, rebel, and entrust their hopes to their friends to fight corruption, confront evil, and challenge fate.

name: The Red Bell’s Lament
summary:
The Redbell Tree scrapes the sky, standing proudly in the heart of Hemeria, a land of sunlight. In a land ruled by a monarchy for generations, humans lived in peace and tranquility. That is, until the dawn of the day the world was dyed red.

On that day, vampires laid waste to Hemeria. They preyed on, devoured, and devastated its inhabitants. A great many people would go on to mourn their loved ones, their families and friends, for the rest of their lives. One particular town of Hemeria bore such a tragedy. A single girl was left alone in despair and disgrace. She vowed revenge, and grew into one of Hemeria's finest vampire hunters.

And one day, she became a member of the Elpis 7; those who inspired a light of hope in its people.

One day, she receives a letter from an unknown sender. Upon her arrival to the mansion indicated inside, she finds vampire hunters and a royal knight awaiting her. The hunters assembled receive an order from the monarch.

They are to form a squad and invade Nyx, the world of vampires. A shiver of anticipation crackles through her at the opportunity she's been waiting for her whole life. However, this is but the beginning of a game wherein the fate of her world is at stake. Pawns are sent forth, discarded, hidden out of sight...

And just how many will remain when this all comes to an end?

name: Plus Ultra: Legado
summary: Immerse yourself in a Mesoamerican metroidvania adventure, featuring vivid ligne-claire comic visuals set in the 16th century. Explore the intersection of two worlds in this spellbinding tale base on historical background with rich lore, dynamic combat, and a captivating soundtrack.

name: HardAF
summary: A punishing precision-based, speedrun 2D platformer...in the dark. Uncover the level with every death, earn swag and unlock new chapters. Run, Jump, Dash, Die, Repeat.

name: Into the Grid
summary: Become a master hacker in this cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder. Explore the dangers of cyberspace and fight evil corporations. Build and upgrade a deck of powerful programs. Unlock perks and skills, and unleash digital hell on your enemies. Dive into the grid!

name: Mall Heist
summary: Sneak, hack, and confront guards as a security tester in 'Mall Heist.' Utilize your surroundings to your advantage! From bananas in the supermarket to boots in the clothing store, everything becomes a tool for your heist!

name: Super Reaktor
summary: Super reaKtor is a fast-paced Bullet Hell with original controls, where you must survive by collecting green energy pellets, and avoid or absorb various types of hostile TRI-SKL bullets.

name: Arken Age
summary: Arken Age is a VR action-adventure game set in the Bio-Chasm—a terraformed fantasy world created by the Grand Arborist. Engage in full physics combat using Arkenite infused swords & guns—and freely explore the densely filled environments under siege by Hyperion's neural corruption.

name: Seraph: In the Darkness
summary: Seraph: In the Darkness is a classic dark fantasy. It's an action role-playing game (ARPG) with hack-and-slash combat mechanics, allowing for item customization tailored to your playstyle. Experience new thrills in the world of SERAPH, where aesthetics of darkness and fear combine

name: Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator
summary: Dedicate your life to saving others. As soon as you receive the emergency call, speed off to the site of the accident in your ambulance, sirens wailing. Apply first aid and transport the seriously injured to hospital. Every second counts!

name: PolyPine
summary: Build your own forest! A simulation sandbox game where you grow plants and design habitats for 100s of species. Click on animals to trigger behaviors: deers poop which fertilizes the soil, bees go looking for nectar. Unlock more plants and animals as you create an increasingly diverse ecosystem.

name: Reach to Tsukuyomi
summary: ”Reach to Tsukuyomi" is an exhilarating short 2D action game on a 2D platform. Fight a variety of enemies, powerful bosses, and free your hometown from Yokai in this simple action game. What awaits you at the end of the story, which unfolds in cute dots, can be found at .......

name: Inzoi
summary: InZOI is a life simulation game in which the player takes on the role of an intern at a virtual reality company, managing a neighborhood of simulated characters called "Zoi." Gameplay takes place across open world environments including a dense metropolis inspired by Seoul and a coastal city inspired by Santa Monica. Players direct their characters through careers, relationships, education, and daily needs, while also customizing homes and editing the broader city environment. The game features AI-driven character behaviors, generative AI tools for creating patterns and objects, mod support, and a community content-sharing platform called Canvas.

name: The Art of Reflection
summary: The Art of Reflection is a first-person puzzle game where you traverse mirrors as if they were natural extensions of space. Solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and perform gravity-shifting acrobatics through a sprawling environment as you learn to navigate this world with mastery.

name: Voyagers of Nera
summary: Voyagers of Nera is a cooperative seafaring survival-crafting game for up to 10 players. Sail across a magical ocean world, skim along the waves, and protect lost nature spirits from monsters emerging from the depths.

name: Crime Shop Simulator
summary: Crime Shop Simulator: A Prison Boss Game is a VR crafting game where you play as a shop owner smuggling prohibited stuff. Produce and sell beers, erotic magazines, cigarettes, and more! But watch out, the police are cracking down on contraband!

name: Silent North
summary: Silent North thrusts you into the Swiss Alps, battling the elements, Infected, and other players. Fight solo or team up, scavenging gear and essentials. Intense PVPVE action ensures constant danger. Adapt, be resilient, and survive in this unpredictable, ever-changing landscape.

name: Wizdom Academy
summary: Build and manage your wizard academy as the headmaster. Feel the city-building thrill of constructing your magic school. Recruit students, guide them to become wizards, control resources, customize your castle, and expand your academy's influence and prestige. Start your legacy today!

name: Mecha Break
summary: Mecha Break is a multiplayer mech game that allows players to choose from diverse mechs, customize appearances, and battle colossal war machines on treacherous terrain. Get ready for the ultimate showdown—blitz, brawl, blaze!

name: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance
summary: Slay the enemies in the silence of the moment. Run through the world of Shinobi full of monsters and ninja actions. Grab Oborozuki, the legendary sword, and slay evil once more. Your clan and the world are counting on you.

name: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage
summary: Lost Records: Bloom & Rage is a brand-new story-driven journey through time from the creative minds behind Life is Strange. The magical summer of 1995 is one of self-discovery and forging unbreakable bonds for high school friends Swann, Nora, Autumn, and Kat. 27 years of no contact later, fate reunites them to confront the long-buried secret that made them promise to never speak again.

name: The First Berserker: Khazan
summary: The First Berserker: Khazan is a hardcore action role-playing game. The player will become Khazan, the great general of the Pelos empire, whom overcame death, and sets out to reveal the incidents that led to his downfall and seek vengeance on his enemies.

name: Monster Hunter Wilds
summary: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

name: Rooftops & Alleys: The Parkour Game
summary:
Rooftops & Alleys is more than just a game about Parkour & Freerunning. It’s the adrenaline rush of landing an impossible trick combo, defying gravity, and feeling like you’re flying… until you crash face-first into a dark alley 30 meters below.

In solo or with your friends, explore in total freedom massive-parkour-ready maps. Reach every corner of your playground to uncover hidden spots — time trials, trick challenges, and more! In multiplayer, dive into game modes like TAG, Capture the Flag, Trick Battles, or simply freeroam with your friends!

name: Realms of Madness
summary: Build a medieval fantasy castle, expand it to recruit mythical creatures, and lead them into battle to demolish the enemy stronghold.

name: Hiraeth
summary: HIRAETH is a sci-fi, first-person survival game set on a desolate, alien planet. Adapt to various threats while discovering the secrets of the abandoned, dystopian colony. You can choose between two distinct game modes that share common gameplay mechanics - sandbox and story.

name: Neongarten
summary: Neongarten is a minimalist cyberpunk city builder where you build from the ground up! Find synergies between buildings to maximize taxes, pit mega-corps against illegal hackers, and place toxic waste dumps over coffee shops. Chill out to lo-fi tunes while your city block grows one cube at a time.

name: Nova Hearts
summary: A mysterious force of power transforms you and other highly attractive people in your area into superheroes and villains! TEXT, DATE and FIGHT your friends and enemies alike.

name: Suck Up!
summary: Play as a vampire trying to charm your way into your fully AI-driven neighbors' homes. Speak to them using your voice or text and wear clever disguises to form a convincing story.

name: Pastel Parade
summary: Pastel☆Parade is an exhilarating rhythm game with easy controls! Get into the rhythm with cute and pop music!

name: Brave Escape
summary: Embark on a thrilling co-op adventure in 'Brave Escape,' a challenging platformer demanding teamwork to conquer perilous traps and treacherous terrain.

name: Cruel
summary: Fight your way through 10 floors with powerful guns, crunchy melee weapons and a mighty kick. Although you'd better be fast, as you only have one life, and you're on the clock!

name: Paper Mario: The Origami King Refolded
summary: This is a modpack that builds upon the existing world of Paper Mario The Origami King by adding new characters, enemies, items and more while keeping the existing charm of the original game.

name: Earthion
summary:
Earthion is an upcoming aftermarket shooting game developed by Ancient primarily for the Sega Mega Drive. Physical MD versions will be published by SUPERDELUXE GAMES in Japan and by Limited Run Games in North America. The game will also get a 16:9 version for modern platforms.

Earthion is published under the label YKGGG, a brand name covering all the retro-style games developed at Ancient. If Earthion meets success, Ancient will go on the venture of releasing video games designed for retro consoles. A separate version of the game for Arcade was confirmed by Ancient and published by exA-Arcadia, which features a new, exclusive mode that will not be available in the Mega Drive version.

name: Ritual of Raven
summary: Ritual of Raven is a cozy farming game that lets you be creative in a witchy world by empowering you to dip your toes into the magic of coding. You will meet lots of quirky characters that you can befriend and trade with. You will be able to enchant magical creatures to help you grow the ingredients for your spells. And of course you can be creative, decorate your farm and explore the magical world around you.

name: Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact
summary:
Hunter x Hunter: Nen x Impact is a Hunter x Hunter fighting game,
Published by Bushiroad Games.

Choose your favorite Nen User characters for the 3V3 Team Battle!
The compatibility and order of the teammates are the keys to victory!
Build the strongest team and battle for victory!

name: Virtual Girl @ World's End
summary: A visual novel developed by HEADLOCK about Virtual YouTubers in an apocalyptic world.

name: Urban Jungle
summary: Turn your home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your tiny apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet the cat!

name: The Valley of the Architects
summary: A puzzle game, narratively grounded around architecture, adventure and elevators. Follow architectural writer Liz on a journey through Africa to uncover the secrets of a lost and forgotten Architect. Using your problem solving skills, overcome each puzzle and slowly unwrap the story of a lifetime.

name: Panzerkampf
summary: Panzerkampf is a team vs team World War II and modern era tank battle game for PC. You play with historically accurate models of tanks, their armor, weapons and all their parameters.
