The game includes a full ballistics model with realistic calculations of penetrations and projectile ricochets, an observation/detection and surveillance system, and a physically realistic model of the motion of the tank and its wheels and tracks down to the level of individual track-links.

name: Glitchspankr
summary: After a hard day of existing you just want to relax and play your favorite game, Big Booty Slapper 6! Unfortunately, there seems to be a rogue virus eating and corrupting your precious game! Using the GlitchSPANKR Antivirus software, dive into virtual worlds and Spank that Glitch! Or befriend him. Or spare his poor, ugly, miserable life. Maybe give him a smooch... fall in love... Oh, uhem. Well there are a lot of options. Just... get in there and figure it out.

name: Decks of the Damned
summary: Raise an undead army by night, while by day, fend off human attacks on your lair. Enhance your minions by crafting and looting gear. Discover powerful crafting recipes. Explore lost ruins in quest for rare artifacts. Raid human villages. Shroud the land in darkness under your control.

name: Guntouchables
summary: Guntouchables is a 1-4 player co-op survivor-like shooter. The world has fallen and is overrun by an endless horde of ever-evolving mutants. You and your ragtag group of gun runners must find and deliver crates of classified military supplies before the enemy can take advantage of their content.

name: Goblin Cleanup
summary: A co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again.

name: Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club: Tokimeki Roadmap to the Future
summary: An upcoming visual novel based on Love Live! Nijigasaki High School Idol Club by Bushiroad Games.

name: The King is Watching
summary: The King is Watching is a roguelite kingdom builder. Rule by the power of your royal gaze! Decide between producing resources, training armies, or balancing both, while adapting to unique events every run.

name: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire
summary: Rule the night, become the city's boss! Manage your own nightclub, explore the dazzling nightlife, and stand against rival gangsters. Walk the fine line between the business world and the criminal underworld, dealing with corrupt police and authorities

name: 100 lil jumps
summary: Nara the frog has been cursed and can only make 100 jumps. Complete the challenge and break the curse

name: DC: Dark Legion
summary: DC: Dark Legion is an action RPG set in the DC universe where players assemble teams of heroes and villains to battle threats. Fast-paced touchscreen combat combines character-specific abilities, gear progression, and PvE story missions with timed events and multiplayer arenas. Stylized graphics, collectible roster, and frequent updates for new characters and challenges.

name: Block Shop
summary: Block shop is an automation puzzle game in which basic blocks are transformed and combined to create increasingly complex blocks.

name: GT Manager
summary: Take charge as the ultimate racing manager, leading your GT racing team to victory. Build your team, improve your car, and deploy winning race strategies across 5 official GT leagues, including the pinnacle of endurance racing: the hypercar category! Are you ready to dominate the world of GT racing?

name: Afallon
summary: Explore the dynamic world of Afallon as one of eight powerful classes, each with three specializations, in a 40 square kilometer open-world singleplayer RPG that evolves with your progress, offering challenging dungeons, crafting professions, and unique companions for your adventure.

name: Another Farm Roguelike: Rebirth
summary: Another Farm Roguelike Rebirth is a strategic farming roguelike where you craft, build, gather, and manage to earn money for the increasing rent. Level up, raise animals, and buy new lands. Everything is possible with a bit of money.

name: Animal Shelter 2
summary: Welcome back to the heartwarming world of Animal Shelter 2! Provide a loving home for every four-legged friend in need – play with them, pet them, even dress them up! Get to know them and find them a loving family. Play with your friends and manage your shelter together in co-op!

name: Atomic Owl
summary: Atomic Owl is a pixel art-based single-player, side-scrolling roguelite that combines fast-paced platforming with dynamic hack-and-slash combat and a variety of weapons, powerups, and a demonic blade. Journey through eight roguelite zones, save your friends, and take up arms against Omega Wing!

name: Kemono Teatime
summary: Relax in the world of Kemono Teatime, where animal ears are a normal part of everyday life. Here in Melodius, you can whip up whatever blends of tea you desire in your favorite cafe as you play through an adorable story. Come now and live out your bestest and cutest life—down to the last drop.

name: Grimshire
summary: A deadly plague threatens the village of Grimshire. Manage your farmland, forage the bounty of the wilds, prevent your harvest from rotting away and keep the root cellar full. Can you help bring the community together and survive?

name: Wings of Endless
summary:
Wings of Endless" is an action RPG that captivates with its platforming elements and a rich, pixel-art visual style. The game unfolds the story of Hariku, a confident bounty hunter whose routine mission evolves into an expansive quest, revealing the layers of a long-forgotten war. Accompanied by Owly, his mysterious talking owl, and a cast of unexpected allies, Hariku's journey spans across diverse and vivid landscapes filled with secrets, from desolate deserts and lush forests to icy expanses and marshlands​​​​.

The gameplay is dynamic, emphasizing a combat system that allows players to control three distinct heroes, each with unique abilities, and switch between them in real-time to unleash powerful combos. This system, alongside a vast world ripe for exploration, numerous side missions, a variety of challenging enemies, and intricate puzzles, ensures a gameplay experience that is both engaging and rewarding. Additionally, the game features a crafting system for consumables, further enriching the gameplay with strategic elements​

name: Dark Memories: Prologue
summary: Rent a cabin for a serene weekend, only to face a series of eerie puzzles in 'Dark Memories: Prologue'—an FPS thriller where every clue is a step towards escape.

name: Industry Giant 4.0
summary: Build an industrial empire from scratch in Industry Giant 4.0. Produce goods, build up your industries, construct transportation networks, plan production, manage finances, and navigate global events. Become the next business mogul and write history!

name: Dive The Depths
summary: Dive The Depths is an action-roguelike set beneath the ocean's surface. As a humble diver, you must navigate the world filled with bizarre sea creatures, submerged ruins, and forgotten histories. Can you conquer the depths and unravel the secrets that hidden beneath the waves?

name: Parallel Experiment
summary: Dive into the secrets of the Parallel Experiment in this 2-player co-op puzzle game. Join forces as two detectives to finally catch the infamous Cryptic Killer. And remember - communication is key!

name: Lockdown Protocol
summary: A first-person social deduction game, combining real-time action and communication, 3 to 8 players. While most players will do their best to complete objectives and ensure victory, a small portion of dissidents will try to stop them at all costs, without getting caught.

name: Granvir
summary: Granvir is an action roguelite featuring mech building. Scavenge the battlefield for parts to replace and upgrade your arms, legs, torso and weaponry. PIlot your Granvir and manage your campaign between battles to find the best equipment and stay supplied.

name: Marisa of Liartop Mountain
summary: 'Marisa of Liartop Mountain' is an adventure-roleplaying game, where you, the player, will play as Reimu and explore a mountain of books filled with mysteries and lies in search of the whereabouts of the missing Marisa.

name: The Echo Paradox
summary: The Echo Paradox is a first-person psychological horror game. Humanity stands on the brink of an unsettling revelation – alternate dimensions are real, but eerily without signs of life.

name: Grand Emprise 2: Portals Apart
summary: Survival crafting adventure Through magical portals Into fantasy worlds. Once-in-a-lifetime, high-paced, high-variety. The sequel to Grand Emprise: Time Travel ️

name: Necrophosis
summary: Necrophosis is a first-person horror adventure that immerses you in a nightmarish-hellish world filled with bizarre forms and somber visuals. Explore eerie-surreal landscapes and unravel mysteries in this atmospheric journey through the macabre.

name: Paradigm Island
summary: Paradigm Island is a Narrative RPG where everyday surrealism meets dry wit. Figure out what kind of person you will be, piece together a perplexing mystery by getting to know the people you meet on the way using the skills of your liking, whilst trying not to get lost in your own psyche.

name: Fine Work Act I
summary: Weave Rhythm and Romance! Charm 7 otherworldly clients with your artisan prowess in this rhythm-infused dating sim.

name: The Other Side
summary: Embark on a chilling co-op adventure in The Other Side, an action packed horror experience. Customize your gear, strategize with friends, and uncover paranormal mysteries. Are you prepared to face the unknown together in this immersive supernatural experience?

name: E-Lich: Corporate Souls
summary: There’s no R.I.P at E-Lich Corp! Explore the afterlife in this roguelite bullet heaven that is all about humor, insane power-levels, replayability and awful office jokes. Reap souls along your undead coworkers in a company that values your life. And death. Literally.

name: Polygon Bit Battle Royale
summary: Polygon Bit Battle Royale is a low-poly, massive multiplayer shooter, supporting 50 players per server. Battle on a large scale map with various vehicles combats. Land, loot and survive to win the battle!

name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
summary: A brand-new adventure from the creators of The House of Da Vinci. With new handcrafted puzzles, hauntingly beautiful locations and challenges for your brain’s gray (or blue) matter. You will be able to look at the world through the eyes of one of the most famous inventors, Nikola Tesla.

name: Flora & Fang: Guardians of the vampire garden
summary: Flora & Fang: Guardians of the vampire garden is a whimsical single player or couch co-op adventure! Protect your dad's pumpkin patch from a relentless insect invasion. Engage in charming arcade action, place strategic traps, and battle it out in skill-testing boss battles. Perfect for all ages!

name: Mannequin Mayhem: Physics Ragdoll Shooter
summary: Get ready for a wild ride in "Mannequin Mayhem," the craziest shooter this year! Say goodbye to zombies and aliens; it's time to blast creepy mannequins. Survive endless waves, customize your arsenal, and embrace the chaos. Let's laugh and blast our way through the weirdest enemies ever!

name: Super Arter
summary:
Super Arter is a puzzle/platform game inspired by the Mario vs Donkey Kong, with an emphasis on pick up the key to take to the door solving puzzles. Featuring pixel art inspired by 16bits games.

Jump, throw objects, use switches, dodge traps, defeat enemies and much more to overcome the obstacles in your path, while looking for the key to open the door to the next level, and free your way until you face the boss of each world to collect all Domino Relics.

-Solve various puzzles in up to 5 different worlds with many stages.

-Face a powerful boss at the end of each world

Recover the Domino Relics stolen by the Dark Wizard, solving the most challenging puzzles, facing enemies, collecting gifts, and discovering the best way for Arter to take the key to the door, in this Puzzle/Platform game.

name: 100 Romantic Cats
summary: 100 Romantic Cats - Join the cutest adventure in the Lovely themed locations full of cats! Explore the charming hand-drawn artwork of romantic places and Cats as you embark on a quest to find 100 adorable cats hidden throughout the game. Can you find them all?

name: Node: The Last Favor of the Antarii
summary: NODE: The Last Favor of the Antarii is a 2.5D puzzle platformer about a robot navigating a Cold War nuclear complex. Execute timeline-based commands to control NODE. Unravel mysteries, explore the unknown. Your commands decide the outcome.

name: Traveler's Refrain
summary: Wield your magical instrument and defy the mecha-goddesses of fate in this Song-Casting Story Driven Action-RPG. Explore a forbidden forest as Traveler, and help him reunite with his long lost love as you fight through abominations and solve mysterious puzzles, all while an ancient conflict unfolds.

name: The August Before
summary: The August Before is a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. Clean up and don’t forget your old belongings on your way to the new life!

name: Ender Magnolia: Bloom in the Mist
summary:
Decades after the Rain of Death, a new journey begins in the Land of Fumes, where mystical powers lie beneath the earth. The kingdom’s desire for conquest led to the creation of the Homunculi, machine-like artificial life forms prepared to execute the king’s will. A recent resource-harvesting mission gone awry caused toxic vapors to emerge from underground, driving both man and machine to feral madness.

As the Homonculi devolve into dangerous creatures, guide Lilac –- an “Attuner” with the power to purify those infected by the fumes — on a quest to save the kingdom. With the help of friendly machines and spirits who fight in Lilac’s stead, fend off mechanized legions of lunging carcasses, cannonball-firing corpses and chainsaw-wielding goblins terrorizing the land.

Turn foes into friends by exorcizing corruption from enemy bosses. Wield their powers to add 30 different abilities to Lilac’s combat repertoire in an enhanced battle system where she can equip up to four special abilities at once. Improve Lilac’s odds of surviving this hunt for lost memories by leveling up attack strength, HP, and armor.

Explore the depths, heights and far corners of the kingdom for lore-filled relics. Collect and trade gold for upgraded items at the Blacksmith’s storefront. Combine story fragments from the kingdom’s fleeing inhabitants with Lilac’s forgotten memories. Seek the truth in an atmospheric hand-drawn setting set to the soothing serenades of returning musical group Mili (Ghost in the Shell, Goblin Slayer) with a brand new original soundtrack available for purchase at launch.

name: Ninja Five-O
summary: Ninja Five-O entrenches you into the epic and ruthless voyage of Joe Osugi, who is a detective and players become the Ninja Five-O. Utilize a wide variety of masterful ninja skills to uphold justice by solving treacherous crimes such as bank heists and hijackings. Use unique Ninjutsu moves to protect the city of Zipangu and take down the evil Mad Mask bosses.

name: Duskpunk
summary: A gritty dice-driven RPG, in a steampunk city. You escaped the War, but how to survive? Explore the city. Build up your skills. Decide who to trust. Choose carefully: you might just spark a revolution!

name: Toni Island Adventure
summary: Toni, a pizza-loving sailor dog, shipwrecks on a mysterious island. Solve challenging puzzles, defeat foes, unlock minigames, unravel the island's ancient magic to find your way back home, and don't forget to take a break for a hot slice of pizza!

name: Pokémon Legends: Z-A
summary: A new adventure awaits within Lumiose City, where an urban redevelopment plan is underway to shape the city into a place that belongs to both people and Pokémon. Please look forward to seeing it for yourself.​​

name: Zombie Army VR
summary: Zombie Hitler may have been defeated, but the zombie hordes are still at large and Europe remains in the throes of war. Return to the field as part of the Deadhunters, an elite squad fighting to end the zombie apocalypse!

name: Wren's Resurgence
summary: Wren’s Resurgence is a 2D action platformer where Wren must fight her way through the Yokai-infested lands in order to rescue her sister Swan. With the evil force’s tyrannical grasp on the island, it’s up to Wren to brandish her katana and bring peace back to the land.

name: Troleu
summary: TROLEU is a wacky and chaotic first-person action game that puts you in the shoes of a trolleybus conductor. Keep things rolling smoothly by ensuring passengers' travel validity, but watch out for rule-breakers! From issuing tickets to enforcing rules with your fists, it's all part of the wild ride.

name: Bureau of Contacts
summary: Bureau of Contacts is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players where you confront insidious ghosts and the paranormal controlled by advanced generative AI technologies.

name: Diora
summary:
After a strange accident, you’ll travel across the world to uncover a mysterious force that is manipulating structures and the people around them.

As you explore, you’ll find new ways to solve puzzles, and free each island from the signals controlling it.

name: The Whiteout
summary: The Whiteout is a chapter based, narrative-driven adventure game that takes place in the not-too-distant future. You’ll play as a lone traveler in a dangerous and broken world: society has collapsed, food is scarce, and trust is not affordable.

name: Echoes of Yi: Samsara
summary: "Echoes of Yi : Samsara" is a hard-core martial arts action game that incorporates elements of traditional Chinese culture. In the game, players play a martial arts character who prevents disasters in the world and restores stability and peace to one side.

name: The Roottrees Are Dead
summary: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

name: Sugardew Island: Your Cozy Farm Shop
summary: In this cozy farming game, you have to run your own farm shop. Take care of your animals and your farm, sell your goods to the cute Forest Folk, upgrade the island and fulfill small orders from the Harmony Tree to fill the island with life again.

name: Amerzone: The Explorer's Legacy
summary:
A full remake of a 2001 point-and-click adventure game Amerzone which served as the first game in the later-created Syberia series.

The remake is more like a reimagining of an old classic adventure with new tough puzzles and new challenges.

name: Dragon Is Dead
summary: Dragon is Dead is a hack-and-slash, roguelite action platformer. It offers tons of customization fun with different character skill trees and legendary equipment. Overcome repeated deaths to defeat Guernian, the leader of the Dark Dragons.

name: Sands of Hope
summary: Explore the sandy landscapes of Cydonia as you use your ancestral powers to build and attach magnetic cubes, find energy cores to restore the land's water flow and meet other villagers with the help of a loyal dog!

name: Let's Patiti!
summary: "Let's Patiti!" is a multiplayer party game that supports 2-4 players and can be played online or locally. In the game, you take on the role of an adorable little cat, engaging in a game of chase and cunning competition with your "Meow Meow" friends or AI in the "Meow Meow Forest".

name: Crypt Crawler
summary: Descend 16 monster-filled levels to close the gate to the Underworld in this top-down tower defense dungeon crawler. Gather resources, discover blueprints, and build defensive towers to slice, dice, zap, and explode undead hordes. Play solo or 2-4 player local co-op.

name: The Mosquito Gang
summary: Do you want to drink blood and buzz forever? Or to swat an annoying insect with one left hand? Dive into the eternal confrontation between human and mosquito in The Mosquito Gang!

name: The Haunting of Joni Evers
summary: The Haunting of Joni Evers is a psychologically thrilling first-person strollplayer set in the small town of Harvest, Oklahoma. Confront, examine, and reexamine Joni’s memories in this emotional story of estranged family underscored by a malevolent, interdimensional haunting.

name: The Berlin Apartment
summary: The Berlin Apartment tells the moving stories of inhabitants of an apartment in the city of Berlin over the last 120 years in several unique, emotional episodes as a character-driven adventure game.

name: Surviving Ceres
summary: Surviving Ceres is an open world survival game with an emphasis on crafting and base building. Export rare materials and manufactured goods to earn funding used to unlock new technologies and upgrades. Bring in colonists from earth to work advanced facilities to terraform the planet.

name: Leaf Blowing Simulator
summary: Experience the calming tranquility of blowing thousands of leaves around in Leaf Blowing Simulator, the only real-time physics-based simulator that allows you to effortlessly create your own virtual oasis. Shape nature at your own pace and find relaxation in the gentle flow of leaves.

name: Bubumbu
summary: Bubumbu is a short and wholesome hidden objects game with a unique twist in which you get to help lost objects find their way back to where they belong, while exploring fully hand-drawn worlds full of quirky characters.

name: Gug
summary: Type anything, generate a creature. Outwit, outlast, and out-weird your enemies in a sandbox tactics battler with deep simulation systems, wildly varied combat and endless procedurally-generated chaos!

name: Swordhaven: Iron Conspiracy
summary: Swordhaven is a classic party-based RPG. Explore the land of Nova Drakonia, embark on quests unique to your character, discover mysterious artefacts of the ancients, and unravel a hidden conspiracy that threatens the very existence of the world.

name: Sword of the Necromancer: Resurrection
summary: Help Tama to save Koko using the powers of the forbidden Sword of the Necromancer. Turn your foes into allies and reach the depths of the Necromancer's dungeon. Gain enough power to bring Koko back from the dead, no matter the cost. Now in 3D and with a renewed battle system!

name: Device Doctor Simulator 2024
summary: Device Doctor Simulator 2024 offers an interactive and detailed simulation experience of becoming a technology repair expert. In this unique simulation, dive into the complex world of various digital devices, including smartphones, tablets, and smartwatches.

name: Blood Bar Tycoon
summary: Blood Bar Tycoon is a vampire bar management game. Build bars and blood factories, lure humans to harvest their blood, process it, and serve your customers: other vampires. Research quirky machines and deal with hunters! Expand through Crimson City to become a mighty Elder!

name: Potion Shop Simulator
summary: Master the art of alchemy in Potion Shop Simulator, a unique blend of simulation and strategy. Brew potions, manage your shop, and cater to a magical clientele in a single-player or co-op experience of the medieval fantasy world.

name: Drive Beyond Horizons
summary: Rev up your engines and venture into the unknown with Drive Beyond Horizons! Conquer dynamic landscapes, customize your ride, and unearth hidden treasures. Get ready for heart-pounding challenges and endless excitement. Your adventure starts now !

name: Guardian's Guide
summary: A daughter raising sim/RPG

name: Swamp Up
summary: Jump between mushrooms, collect power-ups and break records while exploring your own path through a procedurally loaded map in this innovative endless runner with no lane limitations. Be fast, precise, and skillful to avoid all of its dangers. And most importantly, never touch the water.

name: Void War
summary: Command an ancient starship and fight your way to the heart of a dying Empire. Fend off attacks from demented cultists, craven space pirates, and xenophobic Imperial soldiers. Discover powerful artifacts and use them to build your ship into a fearsome war engine.

name: All the Mods 9: No Frills
summary: ATM9 has over 400 mods and countless quests and a built in proper endgame. No Frills has way less mods but the same endgame.

name: Cyber Volley
summary: A 2D Side Scroller like you never seen before! Cute characters and locations await you in this unique game. Bump the volleyball around to reach the goal. The character has precise controls, while the ball is physics-based.

name: Seekers of Skyveil
summary: MOBA + EXTRACTION. Team-based PvPvE with top-down combat, where players battle for powerful loot against rivals. Gear up, make a plan, and set a course for Skyveil. Stealthy treasure runs explode into multi-team PvP chaos in an instant. Extract with your riches—or lose it all.

name: Decktamer
summary: Deck-building meets monster catching in this turn-based roguelike. Recruit enemy cards to your party as you dive into the depths of the abyss. Will you kill them or will you tame them?

name: Phantom Squad
summary: As a team of 2-4 players, communicate, plan, execute and improvise to succeed in this online coop, fast-paced, brutal top-down shooter where tactics are as crucial as skill.

name: Hopeless Sea
summary: Hopeless Sea is a vertical arcade shooter roguelike where you pilot a ship to escape hordes of random frenzied sea monsters. Arm yourself with a variety of gears and traits as you navigate through the madness and uncover the mysteries lurking beneath the waves.

name: Hangry
summary: Explore the galaxy. Discover new life. EAT IT. Play as Hangry, a beastly mercenary with an insatiable hunger hunting down fearsome monsters in this snack n' slash RPG. Traverse mouthwatering hunting grounds to find ingredients for Goutra, the chief chef of an underworld diner in an alien city.

name: Lost in Prayer
summary: Lost in Prayer is a traditional grid-based roguelike in which everything that kills you becomes playable. As a disembodied soul, possess the inhabitants of the afterlife to conquer either Heaven or Hell as you seek the final deliverance you were promised.

name: Another Try 2
summary: The virus has devastated cities and lands. Most of the population died, the rest turned into the walking dead. You're one of the last survivors. Do whatever it takes to last another day.

name: Lidar Exploration Program
summary: LiDAR Exploration Program is an atmospheric short horror game where you explore the world using a scanner.

name: Gentoo Rescue
summary: A puzzler about sliding penguins and walruses. Pickup items to push, pull, bounce, swap, stop, steal, or explode. Solve tightly-designed challenges in a world of puzzles inside puzzles inside puzzles.

name: Devil Jam
summary: Rampage through hell’s metal artists and their countless followers! Immerse yourself in a hand-animated, survivor-like experience that blends beat-driven combat with a unique 12-slot inventory system, allowing for near-infinite demonic builds.

name: Sworn
summary: SWORN is a 1-4 player co-op action roguelite. Explore and reclaim a fallen Camelot from the reign of a corrupted Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table.

name: Nyan Heroes
summary: Step into Nyan Heroes, a free-to-play, third-person hero shooter where intelligent cats pilot powerful mechs known as Guardians. Experience agility, strategy, and precision in a world shaped by feline intelligence.

name: Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo
summary: Are you ready for the first Yoyovania?! In this 2D top-down adventure you'll explore a sprawling urban landscape, reinterpreting your surroundings through your mastery of yoyo tricks. Combine moves for traversal, fight the city's rival crime lords, and regain the influence of the Pipistrello family!

name: Enso
summary: Slingshot your way to the top of a beautiful minimalist landscape. A deceptively tricky platformer where a single slip could lead to a long fall back down!

name: Quadricolor: Ultra Sentai Color Ranger
summary: Put on your sentai hero suit and join the chromatic battle! Protect the color balance in this lightning-fast 2D arena shooter. Snack it on with friends on a couch or online up to 4 players. Fight against evil forces and rise through the ranks in Quadricolor: Ultra Sentai Color Rangers.

name: Ringo's Roundup
summary: Solve grid-based puzzles, guide Postbunny Ringo's car through a variety of environments and collect all the scattered envelopes in this cute pathfinding puzzle game!

name: Tiny Aquarium: Social Fishkeeping
summary: A happy aquarium that lives at the bottom of your screen! Tiny Aquarium is a social idle simulator that keeps growing, even when offline. Hatch, sell fish, decorate, go fishin’, and visit your friends’ aquariums with bite-sized daily sessions.

name: Zoe Begone!
summary: Hand-drawn bullet-hell! A frenetic shooter combining the run-and-gun mechanics of Metal Slug with the infinite loops and shmup-ing of Resogun, wrapped up with old-fashioned drawn-on-film style animation. Fight your own creator as the artist bears down on you with pen and paintbrush!

name: Last Standing
summary: This is an action game in which players compete to defeat the number of enemies that appear from the left and right sides of the screen. The most distinctive feature of the game is the control method, which is innovative and original, like banging on a keyboard.

name: Holy Shoot
summary: In Holy Shoot, the player embarks on a journey as a member of The Sanctum. The ultimate goal is to defeat the powerful demons that represent the Seven Deadly Sins. Each character, is granted unique abilities and traits that make them valuable assets in the fight against demonic forces.

name: Merchants of Rosewall
summary: As a new Merchant in the bustling city of Rosewall you'll manage your own shop, craft artisan goods, hire Companions, and even unravel a mystery of the city! Immerse yourself in a fantasy world where conflict is a thing of the past in this narrative driven, fantasy shop keeper simulator.

name: Maliki: Poison Of The Past
summary: Join Maliki and her wacky family in their epic battle against Poison, a fearsome plant creature that has colonized space-time. Go along on a fantastic odyssey through the ages that provides a unique mix of exploration, temporal riddles and turn-based fights full of surprises.

name: Foundation: Galactic Frontier
summary: Command Asimov's OFFICIAL Foundation universe! Live the life as an interstellar trader to exploit your trade routes! Build your starship home, crush enemies in explosive shootouts & outsmart rivals with fleet strategies in epic space wars - with new content expanding your saga!

name: Worshippers of Cthulhu
summary: LEAD the CULT OF CTHULHU. Decide the fate of your followers, perform eldritch rituals, and master the art of city-building in a world where the line between sanity and madness blurs. Can you endure the horrors you unleash?

name: Tails of Iron II: Whiskers of Winter
summary: Embark upon a vast, snow-ravaged kingdom in Tails of Iron 2, sequel to the critically acclaimed action-RPG. As Arlo, heir to the Warden of the Wastes, adventure through harsh northern lands, home to giant beasts and ragtag bandits, in an epic quest to overcome an ancient, blood-starved evil.

name: Knights in Tight Spaces
summary: Control your environment, gather your party, and build your best deck to overcome outlaws and supernatural forces, across a rich fantasy world. Watch as your tactical choices and deckbuilding prowess play out through stylish fight sequences.

name: Kickback
summary: Kickback is a top-down shooter with roguelike elements, where shooting is the only way to move. Repel waves of mutants, create combinations of weapons and upgrades to optimally navigate the enclosed arena and avoid collisions with enemies.

name: Somber Echoes
summary: Take the role of the resurrected Adrestia and embark on an epic journey to prevent your twin sister from unraveling the universe. Master acrobatic combat, explore the Greco-Roman space vessel Atromitos, and shape your destiny in Somber Echoes.

name: 3D Skills Start Here
summary: Want to learn Blender but don't know where to start? START HERE!

name: Chocolate Factory Simulator
summary: Enter the world of steam and sugar and become a master chocolatier in Chocolate Factory Simulator. Craft gourmet chocolate for your customers in your steampunk workshop with the help of your automaton assistant Nougat.

name: Microtopia
summary: Become the hive mind of a robot ant colony in Microtopia! Use pheromone trails to create, automate and optimize supply chains for your ants to follow. Collect resources, produce goods, feed your queen, grow your colony and fly out to expand the species!

name: Calamity Angels: Special Delivery
summary: A rag-tag group of kooky carriers protect and trek packages through treacherous terrains in this delivery service RPG!

name: Hauntsville
summary: You're a nameless traveler, stranded in a ghost town in the Cursed West. Use your wits, elbow grease, and the iron on your hip. Build a homestead, work the land, and survive against unspeakable monsters in this unique Western horror survival game - alone or with friends!

name: School 666
summary: School 666 is a 1-4 Player Co-op Survival Horror. You must escape this endless nightmare. Try to identify the correct path and survive the anomalies in this endless school. Some extremely powerful anomalies will catch you to their dimensions. Explore the reason why you are here... and don't die.

name: Old School Rally
summary: A nostalgic racing game that combines the charm of classic retro style visuals with the thrill of international rally competitions.

name: Rift Riff
summary: Rift Riff is a minimalistic tower defense game. Build towers at strategic locations and survive increasingly more difficult waves of enemies.

name: Shape of Dreams
summary: Shape of Dreams is an action rogue-lite infused with MOBA-esque elements. Venture into a vivid dream world, and create your own champion by freely swapping skills with whatever you like. Play solo against all odds, or with friends in a 4-player co-op game.

name: Dollhouse: Behind the Broken Mirror
summary:
Enter the broken mind of Eliza de Moor, a once-celebrated singer, now trapped in the labyrinth of her own forgotten memories. The only hope for recovering her memories lies with Doctor Stern and his experimental medicine. As Eliza, you'll navigate the reality and the world behind the broken mirror, guided by the effects of the drug.

Will you be able to piece together the mystery of your past, or will you get lost in this dark and twisted reality?

name: Super Farming Boy
summary: Your farm is under attack! Fly, harvest, grow crops & whack enemies with your shape-shifting one-button superpowers as you seek revenge from your evil nemesis, Korpo, who has captured your mom & friends! An action-puzzle farming sim featuring chain reactions and combos.

name: Commander Quest
summary: 'Commander Quest' is a unique roguelike that combines the deck-building card game genre with real-time strategy gameplay. Experience a one-of-a-kind gameplay where cute but brutal fantasy units engage in battle. Think about the synergies between your cards and the interactions between units on the field, and enjoy a game that offers both originality and depth.

name: Randomice
summary:
A procedural Metroid-like with no fights, focused on exploration and route-planning, in which you play a mouse trying to escape from an ever-changing house.

Each run is a compact Metroid-like experience, in which you will find upgrades to explore the house differently each time. From a magnetic grapple to reach a metallic faucet, to a rideable rocket that can burst through the glass blocking the way, you will find many upgrades, each with its own uses.

You must adapt to the tools in your possession to determine where you can go, the thrill of the game coming both from the platforming mastery, but also from the mental mapping of where you can go in the house at any given time. When you obtain a new item, you need to update this mental map to determine the best possibilities, optimize your path, and decide where to go next to maximize the chances to exit quickly.

The ability to follow an efficient path is important during races, in which all the competing players will have the same game configuration and must exit the house as fast as they can. But the game is also designed to be enjoyed solo and slowly, thanks to a single-player progression that lets each player discover the challenges at their own pace.

name: Egging On
summary: Face the challenge of being a real, fragile egg. Climb out of the hen house and survive in a shop, a kitchen, and other dangerous areas. Roll, jump, and use the environment to reach new heights. Don't break your eggshell, and do your best not to fall. With determination, you may reach freedom!

name: Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch
summary: Vambrace: Dungeon Monarch is a unique combination of Deck-Building and Dungeon Defense, with a wide variety of military units and combinations, strategies and magic manifested in cards. Make your dungeon more dangerous by defending it against increasingly powerful enemies.

name: As We Descend
summary: The roguelike deckbuilder with the soul of a strategy game. Recruit, upgrade, and deploy your forces in tactical battles against corrupt creatures. Make hard decisions in humanity’s final city to bolster your odds. Will you break the cycle of endless descent?

name: SaGa Frontier 2 Remastered
summary:
SaGa Frontier 2 Remastered is a nonlinear RPG focused on exploration, political intrigue, and character-driven storytelling. Players guide a mysterious protagonist through rival city-states and supernatural threats, using strategic turn-based combat, customizable party development, and branching narratives that shift with player choices.
The remaster sharpens the original’s impressionist watercolor visuals to higher resolution, rebuilds the UI for smoother play, and adds new events and playable characters that expand Sandail’s stories. New systems include Parameter Inheritance for deeper stat customization, enhanced boss encounters for tougher challenges, recruitable diggers who can return with expedition loot, plus quality-of-life additions like high-speed modes and New Game+.

name: Party Club
summary: Party Club is a multiplayer adventure that lets you manage a lively venue with up to 4 friends. Whether it's tossing orders to patrons or cleaning up after a busy day, Party Club promises endless fun and hilarious moments with your fellow pals!

name: Liminality
summary: Liminality is a single-player exploration game focused on liminal spaces, but mainly the poolrooms. Dive into the eerie but relaxing lukewarm water of the poolrooms. Navigate through the liminal spaces, where reality blurs, and uncover the secrets that lie beneath the surface

name: Eternal Strands
summary: Fight epic, towering creatures while blending magical abilities with an arsenal of powerful weapons to keep the world from crumbling in this third-person, action-adventure game.

name: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons
summary: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons is a First Person Idle Dungeon Crawler game with 6 unique races to choose, robust combat, a grand saga spanning a continent full of unique kingdoms, free-form skill system, and a guild management system to master as you uncover the secrets of the world of Dragaea!

name: Kebabstar
summary: From desert to stars! Craft your path to fame with Kebabstar! From desert hardships to star-studded parties, become a social media phenomenon by mastering the art of kebab-making and outshining your enemies.

name: DeTechtive 2112
summary: DeTechtive 2112 is a co-op, stealth/action game from an isometric perspective with a linear storyline set in a cyber universe.

name: Dark Sword: The Light of Ainn
summary: Dark Sword is a frenetic action game that mixes bullet-hell and hack-n-slash in the midst of a devastating and dark open world with a tragic backstory, where the player must immerse himself in order to defeat the powerful guardians that guard it.

name: Midori no Kaori
summary: Welcome to Midori no Kaori, a relaxing cozy game that allows you to create your own Japanese shop and manage customers. There are no winners or losers here, just unleash your creativity and enjoy a unique experience.

name: Stygian: Outer Gods
summary: Dive into a hostile world that challenges your very existence, in this survival horror game with RPG elements. Unravel a thousand-year-old mystery, risk your sanity and face the Outer Gods with your skills. Every bullet and the decision counts now, are you up to the task?

name: Undusted: Letters from the Past
summary: Undusted: Letters from the Past is a casual game focused on restoring dirty items to their pristine state. Use a variety of tools to return objects to their original appearance. As you clean each item belonging to the protagonist, reflect on the significance and stories behind them.

name: Deadly Footprints
summary: You find yourself being chased through snow-covered terrain by a relentless killer who is tracking your every move by following your footprints. Run, sneak, hide and use the items you find to evade the killer, in a pixelart horror game where every step you take could be your last.

name: Godslayer Arena
summary: Godslayer Arena is a fusion of autobattlers and action-rpgs. Draft a set of synergizing spells for your Godslayer to cast and witness their power as they take on the arena. Combat is performed automatically, and success is determined through strategic build creation.

name: Hyperbeat
summary: Embark as a knight in an order chasing your potential. Featuring an original soundtrack, precision rhythm gameplay, character customization, and a story following an ensemble cast, only one question remains. What will you find at the peak of what you're chasing?

name: Jötunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
summary: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Norse Gods, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

name: Rise of Industry 2
summary: Navigate the competitive industrial landscape of vibrant 1980's USA! Make strategic manufacturing decisions, optimize production chains, acquire technologies, and expand your global business network with key contacts. Opportunities await those savvy enough to capitalize on them!

name: Jetrunner
summary: JETRUNNER is a parkour FPS, with cel shaded, comic like visuals, and a gameplay loop that can be best described as Trackmania meets Titanfall. Rich, expressive movement, and tight gunplay is what JETRUNNER is all about.

name: Vindefiant
summary: A disgruntled employee is fired from his job, sparking a path of rage and destruction. Lead Alyx through his journey of vengeance and creatively kill enemies in this pixel-art adventure where you, are the villain.

name: CyberTaxi: Lunatic Nights
summary: CyberTaxi Lunatic Nights is a free roam taxi driving simulator set in a dark-noir Prison City. As a cab driver you have to find your wrongfully accused sister and rescue her from this dystopian city-facility. Complete unique missions, defeat lurking thugs and maintain your fuel level to succeed!

name: Cold VR
summary: COLD VR It's the non-stop VR experience. With its twisting mechanics, this game will turn you into an unstoppable machine as you adapt and overcome challenges in each level, you are in control of time. Every time you stop, time flows; you move, it slows down. So, keep on moving!

name: Legends of Elysium
summary:
Legends of Elysium is a fantasy game combining the mechanics known from trading card games and board games.

Unleash powerful decks and strategize across unique boards in this free-to-play strategy. Dive into a rich fantasy world and build your collection of tradable cards.

Challenge your friends, build your fortune and carve your legend in Legends of Elysium!

name: Desert Race Adventures
summary: Embark on a thrilling rally adventure across Europe and Africa in Desert Race Adventures! Manage your team, vehicle, and resources strategically to navigate treacherous terrains and claim victory. Every decision counts in this intense desert racing challenge. Will you lead your team to glory?

name: Terra Foliata
summary:
3D first-person adventure game. A meditative, thoughtful journey without violence, monsters or jump scares. Atmosphere inspired by the works of David Lynch.

Explore the Valley of Mists, where dreams create reality. Study people's dreams and determine their fate. Leave the hectic world for a while and return to yourself.

name: Swing Into Zero-G
summary: Fast-paced multiplayer racing game set in the vastness of space. Compete against friends or online rivals in intense races, where quick reflexes and strategic use of diverse skills determine the victor. Embrace the challenge of swinging your way to victory in this exhilarating space-themed race!

name: Extinction Rifts
summary: Extinction Rifts is a fast-paced FPS where you get stronger as your combo increases! Inspired by classic shooters, you will battle your way through secret enemy headquarters and destroy the Ancient Monoliths with your devastating gauntlet!

name: UnderMine 2
summary: Delve back into the heart-pounding depths of the Undermine in this action roguelike sequel! Uncover ancient secrets, battle fierce foes, and conquer Delvemore Castle with a friend by your side!

name: Darkest Dungeon II: Kingdoms
summary: Kingdoms is a free standalone campaign game mode coming to Darkest Dungeon II. This new game mode challenges players in a desperate race against the clock to find and defeat a monstrous threat before it overwhelms and destroys the Kingdom. Journey across the land to gather resources and battle evil incursions, all while defending a network of safe haven Inns.

name: The Rogue Prince of Persia
summary:
The Rogue Prince of Persia is a 2D action-platformer developed by Evil Empire in collaboration with Ubisoft. The game combines fast-paced parkour movement with roguelite combat and progression systems. Players control the Prince as he battles enemies and explores procedurally generated levels filled with traps and hazards.
Each run offers new weapons, upgrades, and choices that influence gameplay and replayability.

name: Splatterbot
summary: The cleaning robots have gone rogue! Up to 4-players compete in local-multiplayer to make the most mess! Utilize your environment and power-ups to overwhelm your opponents with untidiness. It's about to get messy..

name: Nunholy
summary: In a world overrun by vampires, nuns with their own stories have arrived at the Hunter's Guild. They are prepared to borrow even the power of demons if it means defeating their enemies. What fate awaits them?

name: Romantic Escapades
summary: "Romantic Escapades" is an ancient Chinese love simulation game. Through the development of the plot, players gradually develop relationships with various beauties in the game, and then gradually develop deeper and deeper intimate relationships.

name: Beyond the Ice Palace II
summary: A sequel to 1988's action platform game Beyond the Ice Palace released on Commodore 64.

name: Arrogue
summary: Collect, upgrade and unlock powerful arrows and relics to protect and restore your village. For that you’ll have to fight against procedurally generated hordes of enemies in this turn-per-turn, physics-based, roguelike! Explore the map, find the right path and make decisive choices in random events.

name: Rain World: The Watcher
summary: Rain World: The Watcher is an expansion of Rain World. Journey beyond to something, somewhere only ever glimpsed. When the world beneath your feet cracks and crumbles, will you hold on to all you once new? Or dive into the unknown?

name: Carnival
summary: Carnival is an atmospheric folk horror point-&-click featuring atmospheric low-resolution pixel art graphics, multiple locations drawn from Venice itself, and developing relationships with NPCs, allowing the player to influence events in the game and achieve multiple different endings.

name: Cash Cleaner Simulator
summary: Start your money laundering business in this chill simulator! Use various not-so-powerful tools to restore dirty money bills and some unusual items to their full, crisp potential! Spend your hard-earned crypto to upgrade and cozy up your lab! The cash is in your hands!

name: Beholder: Conductor
summary: A Beholder series spin-off. Become a conductor of the Determination Bringer train: monitor passengers, report incidents, and carry out important Ministry assignments — whose level of secrecy depends only on your loyalty. And remember: mission success is very important to you!

name: Master of Command
summary: Take command in Europe's greatest 18th-century war. Equip & customize regiments, manage supplies, and engage in brutal real-time battles across procedural campaigns. Resources and replacements are scarce, and keeping your best men alive may matter more than any single victory.

name: Sudoku Acres
summary: Sudoku Acres is a cozy cross-up of farm building and puzzle solving. Grow your skills and your environment as you complete Sudoku puzzles, acquire animals, and unlock decorations your farm.

name: Love at The Milky Way Diner
summary: A LGBT-friendly cozy sci-fi cooking/dating sim about making friends, finding love, and running a diner in deep space.

name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
summary: A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure - through the eyes of young Henry - as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.

name: Biped 2
summary: Adorable robots are back to save the day! Explore an unknown planet in this puzzle action-adventure game and experiment with our unique, innovative mechanics solo or in co-op with up to 4 players!

name: Windward Horizon
summary: Windward Horizon is an upcoming RPG-adventure set on the high seas, a sequel to the game Windward released on Steam in 2015. Trade, quest, fight, or just sail the world and fish — it’s your choice, and you can do it alone or together with your friends.

name: Project Silverfish
summary:
Project Silverfish is an immersive sim, FPS where you rely on your own wits and diverse sets of tools and weapons to survive!

Venture deep into a hostile and mysterious exclusion zone to hunt powerful artifacts, fight horrifying creatures and descend deeper into lost, cold-war era dungeons!

Solve complex mysteries, tracing the paths of other explorers, and digging up terrible secrets once lost to time.

Work to uncover the dark secrets of your people's origins, and humanity's extinction...

name: Jitter
summary: Jitter is an immersive sci-fi exploration and survival game set on a mining colony and its outskirts in the Main Asteroid Belt. You assume the role of an experimental AI that maintains ship functions and engages with the crew on board. As you explore the mining colony, you will take on new missions, expand ships and bases using various modules, add survivors to your crew, engage in space fights, and repair the damage left by enemy fire and onboard accidents.

name: A Rite from the Stars: Remaster Edition
summary: When the stars descend on Kaikala they choose a young boy to leave childhood behind and become a legend. It’s time for Kirm, a mute but skilled boy, to overcome the challenges that await in the wisdom, courage & spirit paths in this touching story with several endings!

name: Tortuga City
summary: Survive Tortuga City as a wanted turtle. Defend yourself against the police, build a rebellion, endure dynamic weather, and find an escape route within 50 days before the police deploy their secret weapon.

name: Mohrta
summary: Mohrta is a nonlinear FPS game blending action, exploration, and light dungeon crawling. Explore a vast selection of unique environments, slay an enormous cast of otherworldly creatures, and upgrade your arsenal of multifaceted weapons.

name: Arena Breakout: Infinite
summary: Arena Breakout: Infinite is a tactical extraction shooter featuring PvPvE combat. Players enter raids where they fight both AI enemies and other players, collect loot, and attempt to escape the map alive. Failing to extract means losing all acquired gear. The game emphasizes realistic visuals and sound design.

name: Velev
summary: Dive into VELEV's depths, a hidden world where technology and nature merge. Embark on quests, battle monsters, and unveil mysteries with enhanced gear. Experience intense PvPvE combat, strategic team play across diverse classes, and continuous character growth through exploration and extraction

name: Centum
summary: An unreliable narrative-driven adventure game. You are trapped, and you must escape. But is that really the goal?

name: Promise Mascot Agency
summary: Explore the cursed town of Kaso-Machi! Recruit and train mascot friends! Help out when jobs go wrong! Solve the mystery of your exile! Help Pinky work through her many anger issues! Turn Promise Mascot Agency into the best agency in Japan! Go go, Michi and Pinky!

name: Call of the Void
summary: "Call of the Void" picks up where "Call of the Machine" leaves off. With our protagonist trapped in the void, suddenly, they hear a voice in their mind. The entity speaking identifies itself as one of the ancient gods Vadrigar, who proposes to the protagonist to escape the void by sending them on a new mission for revenge against the Stroggs. This is in response to the Stroggs transforming the fallen Vadrigars (Chton and Shub Niggurath) and their followers into partially mechanical creatures in the service of the Strogg leader Makron.

name: Goodnight Universe
summary: You are Isaac, a 6-month-old baby, developing mysterious psychic powers. What you want most is to be loved and accepted by your family, but a secretive tech corporation wants you for their own.

name: Pokémon Odyssey
summary:
Embark on a perilous journey into the Yggdrasil Labyrinth, a colossal desert maze on Talrega Island rumored to hold untold treasures or lost civilizations. As Nyx, a new guild recruit, your quest to unravel its depths takes a disastrous turn, transforming exploration into a desperate fight for survival and truth within the enigmatic roots of the world tree.

This story-driven Pokémon adventure ditches gyms and evil teams for pure dungeon crawling! Experience double battles, resource gathering, FOE evasion, and naval exploration. Enjoy deep customization: all Pokémon have perfect IVs, EVs are managed via items, and natures/abilities can be changed. Explore Gen 1-3 with new Etrian Variants, side quests, and a rebalanced, grind-free experience focused on strategic depth.

name: Tiny Garden
summary:
Tiny Garden, build your own magical garden inside a 90s toy
Plant your vegetables and trade them for furniture to customize tiny gardens in this delightful mix of farming, puzzle and strategy

name: Sonic Rumble Party
summary: Ready, Set, Rumble! Join Sonic in this intense arcade royale game set in Dr. Eggman's diabolical Toy World. Collect legendary skins, all-new emotes, and build skills as you progress through this action-packed game! Mayhem is best with friends!

name: Garten of Banban 8: Anti Devil
summary: Explore the most obscure levels of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive the new deceives and mysteries that await you. Uncover the truth behind the place, and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

name: My Little Life
summary: A desktop companion that lives on the bottom of your screen. Expand and decorate their home to keep them happy. Help them live their best life while you focus on yours.

name: Assassin's Creed Shadows
summary: Experience an epic historical action-adventure story set in feudal Japan! Become a lethal shinobi Assassin and a powerful legendary samurai as you explore a beautiful open world in a time of chaos. Switch seamlessly between two unlikely allies as you discover their common destiny. Master complementary playstyles, create your shinobi league, customize your hideout, and usher in a new era for Japan.

name: Total Chaos
summary:
Total Chaos is a relentless survival horror experience from Trigger Happy Interactive (creator of Turbo Overkill) and Apogee Entertainment. Washed ashore on Fort Oasis, a long-abandoned mining colony swallowed by decay, players must scavenge for supplies, craft makeshift weapons, and navigate a world where hallucinations warp reality and unspeakable horrors lurk in the shadows.

With dynamic AI-driven enemies, a Madness system that distorts perception, and a brutal fight for survival, Total Chaos pushes the boundaries of psychological horror. Every bullet counts, every wound matters, and your own mind may be your worst enemy.

Prepare to descend into madness. Total Chaos launches in 2025 on PC via Steam, with an optional VR mode for those brave enough to step inside the nightmare.

name: Los Pingheros
summary: Duck, dodge and toss. Los Pingheros is a multiplayer brawler for up to 8 players online or local. Join hectic battles in various modes and strive to become the ultimate Pinghero in Mexico by snowing your opponents out of the arena.

name: Natures Ascendancy
summary: Natures Ascendancy" is an exhilarating open-world survival game where players explore a mysterious alien planet, uncover ancient secrets, and survive its treacherous environments. With stunning visuals and immersive gameplay mechanics, embark on an unforgettable journey of discovery and survival.

name: Adorable Dog: Gnomeageddon
summary: The Gnome Legion has attacked! Save your friends, defend the village and bring the fight to the gnomes! Travel to unique worlds and recruit your animal buddies to help destroy those gnome once and for all!

name: Trench Tales
summary: A story-driven third-person action game set in a dark, alternative world between WWI and WWII. Harness unique powers, customize your arsenal, and navigate haunting Gothic landscapes. Battle fallen soldiers as you uncover the mysteries of this realm.

name: Deck Defense
summary: Deck Defense is a deck building tower defense game, where the player controls both their defenses and the expansion of the map. Expand your deck after each wave with one of over 65 cards to choose from, and try to keep the enemy blobs from reaching the portal.

name: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Thrown to the Dogs
summary: Thrown to the Dogs is a downloadable content pre-order expansion package for Assassin's Creed: Shadows that is expected to release alongside the main game. It will involve helping a loyal dog avenge his late master.

name: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Gold Edition
summary:
Assassin's Creed Shadows takes players on an epic historical action adventure set in feudal Japan. Step into the roles of both a deadly shinobi assassin and a legendary samurai as you navigate a stunning open world during tumultuous times. Seamlessly switch between two interconnected characters to uncover their entwined destinies while mastering unique playstyles.
Build your own shinobi league, customize your lair, and influence the future of Japan as you embrace the chaos of this immersive journey.

The Assassin's Creed Shadows Gold Edition includes:
- The base game
- Up to three days early access to the game
- The Season Pass with a bonus quest at launch and two later expansions.

name: The Executive: Movie Industry Tycoon
summary: Shape the history of the Hollywood movie industry in this sandbox business simulation game. Create the movies you've always wanted to see, hire the best team, research cutting-edge technologies, and dominate the Box Office. Can you rise from a small studio to a Hollywood giant?

name: Steel Hunters
summary: Steel Hunters is a Free-to-Play, PvPvE shooter with futuristic mech battles. Fight to collect rare loot on an abandoned Earth, and use combat tactics to turn rivals into scrap. Choose your Hunter and playstyle to battle 5 other duo teams. Only one can extract from the Hunting Grounds.

name: A Building Full of Cats 2
summary: Welcome back to the world of A Building Full of Cats! In this sequel, not only will you be petting all the cats in the building, but you'll also be assisting its residents with various tasks. Can you pet all the cats and make a difference in the lives of the building's residents?

name: Phantom Beast Solitaire
summary: Each start will have a different beginning. The game is set in a cartoon style, with simple and fresh graphics. Players need to deal high damage to defeat their boss through playing cards to clear the level. Suitable for players who enjoy challenges, randomness, and creativity.

name: Drill Core
summary: Corporate greed meets strategic planet-mining in Drill Core! Drill to the heart of planets while managing workers, researching cutting-edge tech, and fortifying against alien attacks. Will you prioritize efficiency and risk your workers' safety, or focus on defense for survival?

name: A Twisted Place
summary: A Twisted Place is an unconventional Single-Player Horror game with multiple chapters. Wander through a disturbing & mysterious place while hiding from entities and find a way out. Interract with the environment to find tools, information and secrets.

name: Three Bulky Bears
summary: The evil circular witch Rolldilocks has kicked the three bears out of their home! Time to get back and kick her out! In this 2D platformer, switch between Baby Bear, Mama Bear, and Papa Bear to navigate a variety of obstacles, as you roll, jump, swim, and smash your way through 50 challenging levels in 5 unique worlds!

name: Cabin Crew Life Simulator
summary: Welcome to Cabin Crew Simulator, the pioneering flight attendant simulator by SOGA Std. Dive into the glamorous world of aviation and kickstart your career by ensuring passenger satisfaction and safety. Navigate through exciting tasks on each flight, from serving gourmet meals to managing in-flight emergencies, providing an unparalleled passenger experience.

name: Restaurats
summary: А restaurant management simulator, where players take on the role of a company of rats striving to be the best in their field. Players are tasked with managing all aspects of the restaurant, starting from cooking dishes and drinks, to serving visitors and developing the establishment

name: All in Abyss: Judge the Fake
summary: Asuha, a self-proclaimed gambling prodigy, challenges the Witch ruling the gambling district. Poised to win, she is defeated by a mysterious power. An adventure of gambling, exposing frauds and earning fortunes through poker.

name: Doom: The Dark Ages
summary: A single-player first-person shooter and prequel to Doom (2016). Set in the dark medieval world of Argent D'Nur, players control the Doom Slayer in a grounded, weighty combat style that emphasizes strategic engagements over the acrobatic mobility of previous entries. The game introduces a Shield Saw for blocking and parrying, new melee weapons, and drivable vehicles including a cybernetic dragon and a massive mech. The narrative focuses on the Slayer's origin story with expanded cutscenes and character development.

name: Clawpunk
summary: Clawpunk is a challenging, fast-paced, melee 2D action game with roguelite elements and multiple characters, where the player can run rampant in a destructible environment that rewards a reactive and aggressive play style.

name: Monster: Titan's Playground
summary: Devastate a fully-destructible city in VR as a giant monster. Battle mechs using your various breath, ranged, and melee weapons—including fire breath, gravity cannon, and lock-on missile pods.

name: Species: Unknown
summary: Species: Unknown is a 1 to 4 players co-op survival horror. Complete high-risk missions aboard an abandoned ship while being hunted by an unknown creature. Survive and upgrade your gear to face each new threat that lurks in the dark.

name: Strange Antiquities
summary: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

name: Alice's World
summary: Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game. Amidst desolate ruins and deserted cities in a world filled with death, the young girl Alice hears "your" voice from in front of the screen. You must guide her forward, solve the mysteries, and reach the top of the tower.

name: Big Helmet Heroes
summary: Throw yourself into an epic 3D beat'em up adventure with adorable knights, full of surprising worlds and situations. Grab your buddy and play in 2 player co-op to save the princess, but this is only the beginning!

name: ToHeart
summary: The late-’90s landmark visual novel from AQUAPLUS is back and fully remade with 3D scenes and animations, full HD resolution, the choice between the original cast or all-new voiceovers, and international translations for the first time ever!

name: Amerta
summary: Amerta is a Zombie Typing Survival Game. Type as fast as you can! Survive zombie waves. SHOOT by TYPING!

name: Bonds of Yachiyo
summary: At sunset, darkness swallowed everything. Bonds of Yachiyo is a Japanese horror tale of two best friends getting separated in a strange version of their own world. Escape from evil spirits, explore and solve puzzles as you try to unravel the truth and reunite the two friends!

name: Corporate Beatdown
summary: Weaponize everyday office items to destroy your coworkers. Exploit a violent work culture and rise the corporate ladder with your fists. Fully destructible office. Questionable promotions. Buckets of blood.

name: Hypogea
summary: Escape from a mysterious underground megastructure in this short atmospheric 3d-platformer.

name: Horse Runner DX
summary: Lead your herd. Survive the chaos. Grow and guide your ever-expanding horse herd in this fast-paced arcade roguelite runner. Stack unique power-ups, master the trail, and push your limits in addictive high-score runs to climb the global leaderboard.

name: Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure
summary: Kun’tewiktuk: A Mi’kmaw Adventure is a fantasy adventure game inspired by Mi’kmaw legend and folklore. It chronicles the adventures of siblings Wasuek ("Flower") and her brother U'n ("Fog"). They get separated one summer morning and they go on an adventure through the spirit world to reunite.

name: Painted In Blood
summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

name: Really Simple Golf
summary: Really Simple Golf is a climbing platformer golf, that blends chill vibes with precision driven adventure. Embark on an adventure across vibrant courses, mastering tricky shoots, navigating obstacles, and sinking those perfect putts.

name: Cage of Roses
summary: A haunting gothic romance set in the 19th century. Follow Meike, a young woman from an impoverished noble family, as she’s swept off her feet by the mysterious Magdalena: a vampire who possesses a dark secret.

name: Dynasty Warriors: Origins
summary: Experience an unrivaled sense of realism on the battlefield, fueled by exhilarating 1 vs. 1,000 action and the rush of massive armies! A nameless hero conquers the turbulent and chaotic Three Kingdoms in this latest DYNASTY WARRIORS series entry.

name: Atomic Exile
summary: Atomic Exile is a top down post-apocalyptic extraction shooter set in the desert wastelands of near future America. You will visit enclaves, explore devastated ruins and encounter NPCs such as other survivors, raiders, mutated beasts and rogue machines.

name: Crisis in the Kremlin: The Cold War
summary: PERESTROIKA - CONTINUATION OF OCTOBER Crisis... Crisis has caught up with the Motherland of the Revolution and lurks in its very heart - the Kremlin. Lead the country through the most difficult times. "Crisis in the Kremlin" opens up huge prospects for you.

name: Sensei! I Like You So Much!
summary: Sensei! I Like You So Much! is a fangirl simulator. Step into the shoes of a passionate fan girl and embark on a journey through the vibrant world of fan culture in this immersive simulation management game.

name: Grit & Valor: 1949
summary: Command an elite squad of Mechs in this alternate World War 2 dieselpunk real-time tactics roguelite. Think fast, battle the Evil Axis forces, and neutralise their HQ. Upgrade your Mechs and Pilots, and develop new strategies to defeat the enemy!

name: BrokenLore: Low
summary: Low, a first-person Horror Game, immerses players in the dark prelude of BrokenLore's story. Set in a mist-shrouded Japanese village, players uncover deep-seated hatred and ancient secrets. Navigate a hyperrealistic, claustrophobic environment where supernatural forces and tragic cycles abound.

name: Maximum Football
summary:
Lead your team to victory in the ultimate football simulation! Start your college career or play with the pros across varied and dynamic stadiums around the country. As head coach, make all the decisions, from drafting your roster to calling the plays. The Maximum Football universe has been completely overhauled to deliver players an ultrarealistic experience that is entirely free to play.

Fully customize your team, recruit your dream roster, and take it to the gridiron locally or online as you build your legacy. Tight, rewarding moves allow players to feel the true sensation of being on the field and smooth, responsive controls mean every play is performed as planned. Live service content ensures fresh chances to up your game as you rise through the ranks to take your place beside the legends.

name: Steve's Warehouse: Physics. Roguelike. Chaos.
summary: Steve's Warehouse is a melting pot of Suika game, rogue-like and deckbuiling. Purchase objects, combine them, but don't make any falls!

name: Swapmeat
summary: Frenetic roguelite meat 'em up action! Rip through alien worlds solo or co-op, harvest mutant body parts to wield their powers, and fulfill your delicious destiny.

name: Yvy
summary: YVY is a fast-paced rogue-lite dice battler set in a world inspired by 16th-century Brazil. Channel the power of ancient divinities, craft your perfect dice by strategically choosing each face, and defend your homeland against the threat of colonial invasion. Roll for resistance!

name: Lost Lullabies: The Orphanage Chronicles
summary: "Lost Lullabies - The Orphanage Chronicles" is a Co-Op horror game set in 1980, inspired by the real stories of an orphanage ruined by a fire in 1960 Lowell. Playable with 1-4 players, the goal is to identify and expel malevolent spirits alone or with your team.

name: Reflex Unit: Strike Ops
summary: Tactical Helicopter Action! Featuring diverse missions; stage daring rescues, manage resources, assault enemy bases and fight back against a sinister enemy. Strategic single and multiplayer gameplay, balance your aircrafts speed, firepower, fuel and load capacity to overcome challenging missions.

name: Aberrant Nights
summary: Aberrant Nights is a first-person psychological horror game. The protagonist will travel to a suburban gas station in the middle of the night to become a part-time gas station worker.

name: A Tithe in Blood
summary: A dark yuri visual novel, about a quiet university student who discovers blood magic in the depths of her grief. Stepping into a world she little understands, Honoka finds unexpected love, and inadvertantly sets in motion a deadly series of events.

name: Into the Emberlands
summary: Venture out into the Emberlands and uncover an ever-changing world filled with surprising encounters and mystical creatures! Save villagers who got lost in the Miasma, collect resources and rebuild your village to create a safe haven for your people.

name: Yooka-Replaylee
summary: Embark on an epic open-world 3D platforming collectathon adventure with Yooka and Laylee! The search for Pagies starts anew in Yooka-Replaylee, the enhanced definitive version of the beloved indie darling with all new challenges, secrets, mechanics, and accessibility options.

name: Starlit Stories
summary: Welcome to Starlit Stories. Relax to calming music as you build and customize your dream campsite. Watch as travelers come and go, adding life to your tranquil retreat. There's no management or deadlines for you to meet. Just wind down and let your creativity flow in this cozy campsite builder.

name: Catto's Post Office
summary: Deliver mail as Catto, the town's dedicated Postcat, while meeting new and old friends in a vibrant cozy town filled with kitty residents.

name: Politics The Game
summary: Become a parliamentarian, create a powerful party, and lead it to victory in this humorous RPG. Manage your popularity and dignity, use unique powers, and navigate a storyline inspired by current events.

name: Cuffbust
summary: Escape prison with your friends by equipping tools, evading guards, and executing your breakout plan. Destructible environments, proximity chat, a multitude of escape routes, 10 player lobbies, and a full custom map editor!

name: Sid Meier's Civilization VII
summary: Rule as one of many legendary leaders from throughout history. Establish your civilization, construct cities and architectural wonders to expand your territory, conquer or cooperate with rival civilizations in pursuit of prosperity, and explore the far reaches of the unknown world. Will you build an empire that stands the test of time?

name: Street Fighter 6: Year 2 - Elena
summary:
Elena is the fourth DLC character in the Street Fighter 6: Year 2 Character/Ultimate Pass.

A cheerful girl raised in the arms of the savannah, and a member of a clan of proud warriors. She has a talent for healing, and seeks to become a veterinarian.

name: Street Fighter 6: Year 2 - Mai
summary: Mai is the third DLC character in the Street Fighter 6: Year 2 Character/Ultimate Pass. The successor of Shiranui-style ninja arts. A charming kunoichi who is as dedicated to love as she is to training. Loves cooking, Japanese dressmaking, flower arrangement, and traditional Japanese dance.

name: Sleep Awake
summary: First-person psychedelic horror set in the far future. In the last known city on Earth, people are disappearing in their sleep. Those who remain exist in a crisis of reckless experiments to keep awake. Katja must navigate depraved death cults, otherworldly forces, and the ever-present horror of The HUSH, to save herself and those who rely upon her.

name: Wanderstop
summary: From the creator of The Stanley Parable and The Beginner’s Guide comes Wanderstop, a narrative-centric cozy game about change and tea.
